We are a residential and commercial cleaning company in California, and we're growing fast. We need a sales closer who turns leads into booked jobs and also takes care of our clients. You won't be just booking appointments. If you have closed sales by phone before and want to earn commission on every deal, read this whole post.



What you'll do

- Call and follow up on new leads within 5 minutes, by phone, SMS and

- Quote, handle objections and close homeowners and business owners

- Handle customer service: answer client calls and
s, reschedule and confirm jobs, and resolve complaints and service issues

- Manage and close support tickets in Zoho Desk, and keep every lead, call and deal up to date in Zoho CRM



What we pay

- $600/month base pay

- Commission on every sale: 0.5% on existing clients and 1% on new clients

- A team bonus

- A long-term, stable position for the right person



Requirements (all required)

- At least 1 year of real phone sales experience where YOU closed the deal (appointment setting alone does not count)

- Customer service experience handling client calls,
s and complaints

- Hands-on Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk experience (other CRM or ticketing tools only if you learn fast)

- Clear, confident spoken English and professional written English

- Reliable internet with a backup, a noise-canceling headset and a quiet workspace

- Able to work a fixed Pacific Time shift, including nights

- Job stability. If you have changed jobs every few months, this role is not for you.



How to apply

 
 with:

1. Your CV

2. Two or three lines on your best phone sale: what you sold, the price, and how you closed it

3. Two or three lines on how you handled an upset customer

4. A 1-2 minute voice recording introducing yourself in English



Important: write CLEAN26 as the first word of your
 subject. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Director, Global Alliances – Accenture
B2B Appointment Setter
description:
About Riovis

Riovis is marketing software that helps direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands manage their marketing activities from one platform.



With Riovis, businesses can:

- Plan campaigns and manage content calendars.

- Create social posts, graphics and short-form videos, then schedule them across social channels.

- Send
 campaigns and manage subscriber lists.

- Build landing pages and run A/B tests.

- Run digital advertising campaigns, including product catalog ads.

- Recruit creators, manage contracts and payments, and operate affiliate programs.

- Manage social comments and direct messages from one inbox.

- Track marketing analytics, attribution and competitors.

The Role

We are looking for a proactive, results-driven B2B Appointment Setter to identify and connect with US-based direct-to-consumer brands.



Your primary responsibility is to find potential customers in the skincare, beauty, fashion, clothing and footwear industries, initiate conversations with business owners and marketing decision-makers, qualify their interest, and book product demonstrations with our sales team.



Our target customers range from independently operated, founder-led businesses to established brands with teams of up to 100 employees.



This is an outbound prospecting role suited to someone who is comfortable researching businesses, starting conversations and consistently generating qualified sales opportunities.

What You'll Do

- Research and build targeted lead lists using ecommerce databases, Instagram, TikTok, wholesale marketplaces, trade show exhibitor directories and other prospecting sources.

- Identify and source at least 50 new potential brands per working day.

- Find and verify contact details for founders, owners and marketing decision-makers.

- Initiate outbound conversations through Instagram DMs,
 and phone calls.

- Introduce Riovis and identify potential business needs and interest.

- Qualify prospects based on company size, marketing channels, existing software, current workflows and budget.

- Identify opportunities where Riovis could replace or consolidate existing marketing tools.

- Schedule qualified product demonstrations with our sales team.

- Provide clear handoff notes covering the prospect's business, needs, existing tools and level of interest.

- Send meeting confirmations and reminders, follow up with prospects, and reschedule missed appointments.

- Maintain accurate prospect records and log all outreach activities in the CRM on the same working day.

- Consistently work toward daily prospecting, outreach and qualified demo targets.

Requirements

- At least 1 year of experience in B2B appointment setting, outbound sales, lead generation or prospecting.

- Experience researching businesses, identifying decision-makers and building prospect lists.

- Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

- Confidence initiating conversations with business owners and senior decision-makers.

- Comfortable with cold outreach through social media,
 and telephone.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage daily activity targets.

- Reliable internet connection with a backup connection available.

- A quiet, professional workspace and a quality headset.

- Ability to work independently and consistently meet performance expectations.

Nice to Have:

- Experience working with ecommerce or direct-to-consumer brands.

- Familiarity with the beauty, skincare, fashion, clothing or footwear industries.

- Knowledge of CRM platforms and sales prospecting tools.

- Spanish language proficiency.

Compensation and Schedule

- Base salary: $800 to $1,200 per month, depending on experience.

- Performance incentive: $30 for every qualified product demonstration attended.

- Unlimited earning potential: No cap on qualified demos or performance incentives.

- Payment: Monthly, in USD.

- Working hours: 40 hours per week.

- Schedule: US Central Time business hours, corresponding to a night shift in the Philippines.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

1. An updated resume.

2. A one-minute voice recording demonstrating how they would introduce Riovis to a potential customer during an outbound call.

Important: Start your application message with the word RIOVIS so we know you have read the full job description.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.

title: Customer Support Assistant (Remote) – Swedish E-Commerce Company
description:
We are a Swedish company looking for a reliable and dedicated Customer Support Assistant to help us manage customer emails for several different brands. You will respond to inquiries in multiple languages using the translation tool DeepL.



Most customer questions will be related to:



Order status (“Where is my delivery?”)



Orders not received



Products not as expected



Returns and exchanges



General questions about the brand



You will work closely with our agents in China who handle packaging and shipping, as well as directly with our payment providers to resolve customer issues without needing our constant assistance.



Important Work Method (Please Read Carefully)



Everything is fully documented in detail, including clear step-by-step instructions on how to respond to each type of customer inquiry.



Every response must be:



Custom-written for each individual customer



Written in the customer’s language (English, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, etc.)



Created using ChatGPT to generate a natural and personalized reply



No copy-paste templates allowed – each message must be unique and tailored



It is very important that the guidelines and instructions are followed perfectly every time.



If you are ever unsure what to do, it is always better to ask questions and double-check. Accuracy is extremely important, and mistakes must be avoided. When in doubt, ask before taking action.



We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented and can maintain high quality and consistency in every response.



We need someone who can start immediately.



Tools & Daily Workflow



We use Google Sheets to track and manage important cases



Examples of cases that may need to be logged include:



Returns



Refunds



Chargebacks



Failed deliveries



Address issues



Customer complaints or special situations



Not all cases need to be logged, but when logging is required, it must be accurate, organized, and consistent



You should be comfortable working with Google Sheets and maintaining clear structure and order



Daily communication and coordination will be done via WhatsApp



Use "I AM READY" when applying for the job or your application will not be read.



What We Expect From You



A fast learner who is driven, organized, and detail-oriented



Someone who is willing to work consistently every day



A patient and polite communicator, even with difficult customers



A problem solver who always tries to fix issues before asking for help



Someone who always finishes what they start



Someone who is technical, consistent, hardworking, and always looking to improve



Strong English speaking and writing skills



Experience with email customer support, Shopify, and Google Sheets is a plus



Work Schedule



7 days a week



Approximately 1–2 hours per day (between 10 AM – 5 PM Swedish time)



Opportunity for increased hours in the near future (5–8 hours/day)



Future Opportunities



You should be willing and excited to learn new skills. Soon, you may also take on tasks such as:



Finding viral products



Searching for ad videos



Editing ad creatives



Writing ad copy



Building simple websites



Creating product descriptions



Communicating with UGC creators and influencers



Experience in these areas is a plus, but not required—we will train you.



Salary



$3 USD per hour



How to Apply



Please share:



A brief introduction about yourself



What you are currently doing



Your ambitions



Your relevant experience



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Solar Project Manager
description:
Job Summary

SpartanX is seeking an experienced, highly organized Solar Project Manager to oversee residential solar projects from contract execution through installation, inspection, utility interconnection, and Permission to Operate (PTO). This position is responsible for tracking project milestones, coordinating across multiple departments, identifying delays, and ensuring projects move efficiently toward completion. We're looking for someone with residential solar project management experience who understands the full project lifecycle, communicates effectively, and takes ownership of resolving issues before they become costly delays.



What You'll Do

Project Management & Coordination

- Manage residential solar projects from contract execution through PTO.

- Track project milestones, deadlines, and outstanding requirements.

- Coordinate with Site Survey, Design, Engineering, Permitting, Installation, Inspections, and Interconnection teams.

- Identify project delays and proactively coordinate resolutions.

- Monitor project readiness and ensure requirements are completed before advancing to the next stage.

- Manage multiple active projects across different U.S. markets.



Project Tracking & Issue Resolution

- Maintain accurate project records, documentation, and status updates.

- Identify missing information, incomplete tasks, and operational bottlenecks.

- Follow up with internal departments to ensure timely completion of outstanding items.

- Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate leadership.

- Monitor aging projects and prioritize actions needed to move them forward.

- Support continuous improvement of project management workflows.



Communication & Reporting

- Provide timely project updates to internal teams and stakeholders.

- Coordinate with homeowners when necessary regarding project progress and outstanding requirements.

- Communicate scheduling concerns, delays, and changes affecting project timelines.

- Maintain accurate CRM and project management records.

- Prepare project status reports and identify trends affecting completion timelines.



What We're Looking For

- Previous residential solar project management experience required.

- Strong understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle, from contract through PTO.

- Experience coordinating multiple departments and managing high-volume project pipelines.

- Knowledge of permitting, inspections, utility interconnection, and installation workflows.

- Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet operational deadlines.

- Experience using CRM systems and project management software.

- Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

- Availability during standard U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing residential solar projects across multiple U.S. states.

- Familiarity with AHJ requirements, utility approvals, and PTO processes.

- Experience identifying and resolving stalled or aging projects.



Schedule

Full-Time | Remote – Offshore

Monday–Friday, aligned with standard U.S. business hours, with occasional additional availability based on operational needs.



What We Offer

- Competitive compensation based on experience.

- Fully remote position.

- Opportunity to work with a growing U.S. residential solar company.

- Collaborative, cross-functional team environment.

- Professional growth and advancement opportunities.



Why SpartanX?

At SpartanX, successful solar projects depend on strong coordination, accountability, and consistent follow-through. Our Project Managers play a critical role in keeping projects moving, resolving obstacles, and ensuring homeowners progress toward system activation.



If you understand residential solar operations, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and take ownership of getting projects across the finish line, we'd love to hear from you.

Solar Done right.

title: Construction Bookkeeper
description:
US Construction Bookkeeper – QuickBooks Online Specialist



Atlantic Diversified, LLC | Remote Position



The rate listed is a trial period/ starting rate and will increase from there based on quality of work. 

Please do not apply if you do not have the qualifications listed below!!!



About Us



Atlantic Diversified is a growing U.S.-based commercial painting and wallcovering contractor. We are looking for an experienced, motivated, and detail-oriented Construction Bookkeeper who wants to become a valued member of our team and grow with our company.



We are seeking more than someone who simply completes assigned tasks. We want a self-starter who takes initiative, identifies opportunities for improvement, solves problems independently, and brings a positive, team-oriented attitude to work every day.



Key Responsibilities



Manage day-to-day bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online (QBO).



Maintain accurate accounts payable and accounts receivable.



Track job costs, labor expenses, materials, and project profitability.



Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial records.



Prepare invoices, monitor outstanding payments, and assist with collections.



Maintain and improve financial tracking systems using Google Sheets.



Assist with payroll processing and subcontractor documentation.



Prepare financial reports and support month-end closing.



Identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements to bookkeeping procedures.



Communicate proactively with management and other team members.



Required Qualifications



Proven experience with U.S. construction bookkeeping — understanding of job costing, construction billing, and project-based accounting is essential.



Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) — REQUIRED.



Advanced working knowledge of Google Sheets — REQUIRED.



Experience managing AP, AR, reconciliations, and financial reporting.



Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Additional Experience — A Plus



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:



ClickUp — task management and workflow tracking



Zoho —
 and business administration



LinkedIn — business networking and outreach



Construction payroll and labor tracking



Developing automated spreadsheets and improving administrative systems



The Person We're Looking For



We value attitude and initiative just as much as technical ability.



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



Has a positive, can-do attitude and genuinely enjoys being part of a team.



Takes ownership of responsibilities without needing constant supervision.



Is resourceful and willing to research solutions independently.



Is comfortable asking questions and learning new systems.



Looks for ways to make processes more accurate, efficient, and productive.



Welcomes feedback and is committed to continuous improvement.



Is dependable, honest, professional, and accountable.



Wants to build a long-term working relationship with a growing company.



Why Join Atlantic Diversified?



We are actively improving our systems and expanding our operations. This is an opportunity to contribute ideas, help develop better processes, and play a meaningful role in our company's continued growth.



We want someone who is excited to learn, contribute, take initiative, and grow alongside us.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining:



Your experience with U.S. construction bookkeeping and QuickBooks Online.



Your experience with construction job costing and Google Sheets.



An example of a process you improved or a problem you solved independently.



Your experience with ClickUp, Zoho, or LinkedIn, if applicable.



We look forward to finding someone who shares our commitment to accuracy, teamwork, continuous improvement, and professional growth.

title: Remote Cold Caller / Appointment Setter / Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
About Us



At StoryGen (storygen.agency), we help B2B companies turn meaningful conversations into new business opportunities.



As a growing lead generation agency, we work with businesses across SaaS, technology, and professional services to strengthen their sales pipelines through strategic outbound prospecting.



Our approach combines dedicated Business Development Representative (BDR) teams, proven cold calling practices, modern sales tools, and ongoing performance coaching. We handle the prospecting process so our clients can focus on building relationships and closing deals.



We believe great sales results come from the right combination of skill, consistency, and determination. That's why we invest in developing our team members through hands-on training, structured processes, and continuous support.



We're looking for experienced Cold Callers / Business Development Representatives (BDRs) who are confident engaging prospects, motivated by performance goals, and eager to develop their careers in B2B sales.



About the Role



As a Cold Caller / Business Development Representative (BDR) at StoryGen, your primary focus will be creating qualified sales opportunities through outbound B2B cold calling.



You'll be responsible for reaching out to business owners and key decision-makers, initiating conversations, understanding their business challenges, and determining whether our clients' solutions could be a good fit.



Your goal is to turn these conversations into qualified appointments that help our clients grow their sales pipelines.



You'll support multiple outbound campaigns, maintain accurate prospect records, and use established calling frameworks to guide your conversations. You'll also receive regular feedback and coaching to sharpen your communication, prospecting, and objection-handling abilities.



If you're comfortable making cold calls, enjoy connecting with business professionals, and take pride in achieving measurable results, this role offers an opportunity to put your experience to work in a fully remote environment.



Key Responsibilities



- Conduct daily outbound calls to business prospects and decision-makers across various B2B industries.

- Engage potential customers in professional conversations to understand their needs and business priorities.

- Evaluate prospect fit, identify sales opportunities, and qualify leads based on campaign criteria.

- Respond confidently to questions, concerns, and objections during calls.

- Schedule qualified sales meetings for our clients and their sales representatives.

- Maintain organized and accurate prospect information, call notes, and activity updates in the CRM.

- Apply campaign-specific scripts, outreach strategies, and established sales procedures.

- Collaborate with team members and participate in coaching sessions to improve results.

- Consistently work toward daily calling goals, productivity expectations, and appointment-setting targets.



Qualifications & Skills



- Demonstrated experience in outbound cold calling, business development, sales development, telemarketing, or appointment setting.

- Excellent spoken communication skills with the ability to conduct clear, engaging, and professional conversations.

- Confidence speaking with business owners, executives, and other decision-makers.

- Strong listening skills and the ability to ask relevant questions to uncover potential business needs.

- Ability to handle rejection, address objections, and maintain a positive attitude throughout the calling process.

- Results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of accountability and personal initiative.

- Ability to stay organized, manage daily priorities, and work productively without constant supervision.

- Previous experience working toward call activity, lead qualification, or booked-meeting targets.

- Familiarity with CRM systems and sales productivity tools such as HubSpot, Nooks, Slack, Calendly, Coda, or comparable platforms is an advantage.



Compensation & Benefits



- Monthly Base Pay: USD $1,000 per month

- Performance Incentives: Uncapped commissions based on performance

- Work Location: 100% Remote / Work From Home

- Work Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM–6:00 PM EST

- Onboarding & Development: Receive structured training, practical sales guidance, and ongoing coaching to help you perform at your best.

- B2B Sales Experience: Gain exposure to different industries, including SaaS, technology, and professional services, while working on diverse outbound campaigns.

- Professional Advancement: Strengthen your prospecting, communication, and business development skills while exploring opportunities for growth as StoryGen expands.

- Collaborative Team Culture: Work alongside motivated sales professionals in an environment that values teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.



How to Apply



Our hiring process is designed to help us understand your experience, communication abilities, and suitability for the position.



To proceed with your application, please prepare the following requirements:



- Updated Resume – Submit your most recent resume highlighting your background in cold calling, outbound sales, BDR/SDR roles, telemarketing, or appointment setting.

- Internet Speed Test Results – Prepare the results of a recent internet speed test to demonstrate your current connection quality for remote work.

- Short Loom Audio Introduction – Record a brief audio introduction using the guide questions included in the assessment. You'll need to provide the link to your Loom recording as part of the assessment process.



Build Your Sales Career With StoryGen



If you have cold calling experience, enjoy turning conversations into opportunities, and want to be part of a growing B2B sales organization, we'd like to hear from you.



At StoryGen, your ability to communicate, stay consistent, and deliver results matters. Bring your experience, develop your skills, and contribute to a team focused on helping businesses grow.



Apply today and take the next step in your B2B sales career.



Apply Here:

title: Staff Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant 

Full-Time | Remote / Offshore 



Position Summary 

We are seeking a Staff Accountant to support the accounting operations of a growing, multi-entity real estate organization. The position will work closely with finance leadership and support general ledger accounting, accounts payable, balance sheet reconciliations, expense management, and monthly and annual close activities. 



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

General Ledger & Balance Sheet Accounting 

Maintain general ledger records and prepare recurring and adjusting journal entries across multiple legal entities. 

Prepare and reconcile bank, credit card, asset, liability, intercompany, and other balance sheet accounts, including supporting schedules for fixed assets, depreciation, prepaids, accruals, and debt. 

Research reconciliation differences, unusual balances, and account activity and communicate findings to finance leadership. 



Accounts Payable & Expense Management 

Manage day-to-day accounts payable, including invoice coding, approval routing, vendor records, payment preparation, and follow-up on outstanding items. 

Ensure expenses are recorded to the appropriate entity, account, property, department, and accounting period. 

Support implementation and ongoing administration of an expense management platform, including transaction review, receipts, coding, reimbursements, and issue resolution. 



Month-End & Year-End Close 

Complete assigned close procedures, including reconciliations, accruals, reclassifications, depreciation, amortization, and supporting schedules. 

Review account activity for missing transactions, classification issues, unusual balances, and significant fluctuations. 

Assist with financial statement preparation and provide supporting documentation for external tax, accounting, and other professional service providers. 



Multi-Entity & Accounting Operations 

Record and reconcile transactions across affiliated entities, including intercompany and due-to/due-from balances. 

Work with property-level accounting reports and supporting information from property management systems and third-party property managers. 

Maintain organized accounting records and assist with accounting procedures, controls, system improvements, and recurring close processes. 





Required Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 

3-5 years of professional accounting experience. 

Strong understanding of accrual accounting, journal entries, general ledger accounting, balance sheet reconciliations, accounts payable, and month-end close. 

Experience preparing account reconciliations and maintaining supporting schedules. 

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills. 

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. 

Strong written and spoken English communication skills and ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a remote environment. 





Preferred Qualifications 

Experience with multi-entity accounting and intercompany reconciliations. 

Experience in real estate, property management, construction, or real estate development accounting. 

Experience with U.S. GAAP and U.S.-based accounting teams. 

Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting systems and property management systems such as Entrata. 





Work Arrangement 

Full-time remote / offshore position with regular working-hour overlap with the U.S. Mountain Time Zone. 

The position will work directly with U.S.-based accounting and finance leadership, with occasional additional flexibility during month-end and year-end close.

title: Remote Cold Caller / Appointment Setter / Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
About Us



At StoryGen (storygen.agency), we help B2B businesses connect with potential customers and create valuable sales opportunities through effective outbound prospecting.



We're a growing B2B lead generation agency supporting companies in SaaS, technology, and professional services. Our goal is to help clients develop reliable sales pipelines by reaching the right prospects and starting meaningful business conversations.



We accomplish this through dedicated Business Development Representative (BDR) teams, strategic cold calling, modern sales technology, and consistent performance coaching. By managing outbound prospecting for our clients, we allow their sales teams to spend more time nurturing relationships and closing opportunities.



At StoryGen, we value individuals who bring determination, strong communication skills, and a willingness to learn. We support our team members with practical training, established sales processes, and ongoing guidance to help them succeed.



We're looking for experienced Cold Callers / Business Development Representatives (BDRs) who are comfortable speaking with decision-makers, driven to meet performance targets, and interested in building long-term careers in B2B sales.



About the Role



As a Cold Caller / Business Development Representative (BDR) at StoryGen, you'll be responsible for identifying and generating qualified business opportunities through outbound B2B cold calling.



Your daily work will involve contacting business owners and key decision-makers, introducing relevant solutions, asking questions to understand their needs, and evaluating whether our clients' offerings align with their business priorities.



The main objective is to convert promising prospect conversations into qualified sales appointments for our clients' sales teams.



You'll contribute to various outbound campaigns, document prospect interactions accurately, and follow proven calling processes to maintain consistent performance. You'll also benefit from regular coaching and constructive feedback to further develop your prospecting, communication, and objection-handling techniques.



This position is a strong fit for experienced cold callers who enjoy professional conversations, can handle objections with confidence, and perform well in a results-driven remote work setting.



Key Responsibilities



- Make daily outbound cold calls to B2B prospects, including business owners and key decision-makers.

- Initiate engaging conversations to learn about prospects' business needs, priorities, and potential challenges.

- Assess lead suitability, uncover potential sales opportunities, and qualify prospects according to campaign guidelines.

- Handle prospect questions, concerns, and objections professionally while communicating relevant value.

- Arrange qualified sales appointments for clients and their respective sales teams.

- Keep CRM information updated with accurate call notes, prospect details, and outreach activity.

- Follow assigned calling scripts, campaign strategies, and established outbound sales procedures.

- Coordinate with teammates, participate in coaching activities, and apply feedback to improve calling effectiveness.

- Meet daily calling expectations, productivity goals, and appointment-setting targets.



Qualifications & Skills



- Relevant experience in cold calling, outbound sales, business development, sales development, telemarketing, or appointment setting.

- Strong verbal communication abilities and confidence conducting professional conversations over the phone.

- Comfortable engaging business owners, senior executives, and other key decision-makers.

- Effective listening and questioning skills to identify business challenges and potential sales opportunities.

- Resilience when handling rejection, with the ability to address objections and remain professional under pressure.

- Self-driven, goal-oriented, and committed to maintaining consistent performance.

- Good organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Experience working toward outbound calling quotas, lead qualification goals, or appointment-booking targets.

- Knowledge of CRM platforms and sales tools such as HubSpot, Nooks, Slack, Calendly, Coda, or similar applications is a plus.



Compensation & Benefits



- Monthly Base Pay: USD $1,000 per month

- Performance Incentives: Uncapped commissions based on performance

- Work Location: 100% Remote / Work From Home

- Work Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM–6:00 PM EST

- Onboarding & Development: Benefit from organized onboarding, hands-on sales training, and regular coaching designed to support your success.

- B2B Sales Experience: Work on outbound campaigns for clients in SaaS, technology, and professional services while gaining valuable industry knowledge.

- Professional Advancement: Continue building your cold calling, communication, and sales development expertise, with opportunities for professional growth as StoryGen expands.

- Collaborative Team Culture: Be part of a supportive, results-focused team that encourages collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.



How to Apply



Our recruitment process includes a structured assessment to help us evaluate your experience, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.



Before beginning your application, please have the following ready:



- Updated Resume – Provide an up-to-date resume outlining your relevant experience in cold calling, outbound sales, BDR/SDR positions, telemarketing, or appointment setting.

- Internet Speed Test Results – Have a recent internet speed test result available to demonstrate your connection's suitability for remote work.

- Short Loom Audio Introduction – Prepare a brief audio recording following the guide questions provided in the assessment. You'll be asked to submit the link to your Loom introduction during the application process.



Build Your Sales Career With StoryGen



If you're an experienced cold caller who enjoys engaging business professionals, generating qualified appointments, and working toward clear performance goals, we'd be happy to consider your application.



At StoryGen, we recognize the value of effective communication, persistence, and consistent results. Join a growing remote team where you can apply your existing experience, strengthen your sales abilities, and contribute to our clients' success.



Take the next step in your B2B sales career and apply to join StoryGen.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR — ECOMMERCE META ADS

Remote | Full-time | $900–$1,500 USD depending on experience



ABOUT MHI MEDIA



MHI Media is a performance marketing agency helping ambitious e-commerce and DTC brands grow. We create and test the ads that drive sales for brands operating at serious scale.



Our creative team is made up of editors, designers, strategists and pod leads working together across a large portfolio of brands. We produce a high volume of creative, learn from performance data and improve quickly — so this is a great environment for someone who wants to become genuinely excellent at advertising, not just make videos that look nice.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-quality Video Editor who understands that a paid social ad has one job: earn attention, communicate the idea clearly and move the viewer towards action.



You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

- Repurpose winning concepts into new hooks, edits, lengths, placements and aspect ratios

- Communicate early when a brief, asset or deadline is unclear or blocked

- Study performance feedback and use it to make future creative stronger



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



- Your first version is already clean, considered and close to the brief

- You understand why a hook, cut, pause, caption or visual is being used — not just how to add it

- You catch spelling, pacing, safe-zone, branding, continuity and audio issues before submitting

- You can take direct feedback without becoming defensive and implement it properly

- You are reliable: deadlines are met, blockers are raised early and tasks do not disappear

- Your work gets better as you learn what performs for different audiences and brands

- Strategists and pod leads trust you with increasingly important work



WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.



You will probably do well here if you are:



- Performance-minded: interested in what makes people stop, watch and buy

- Detail-obsessed: you notice the one typo, wrong product, weak cut or incorrect logo before anyone else does

- A strong brief reader: you follow direction precisely and ask questions when something is unclear

- Coachable: you actively want detailed feedback and use it to improve

- Proactive: you look for the next useful action instead of waiting to be chased

- Fast but not careless: you can work at volume without lowering your standards

- Commercially curious: you want to understand the customer, offer, audience and creative strategy behind the edit

- A clear communicator: you can explain your decisions and flag problems early

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and shared deadlines



This probably will not be the right role for you if you only want to make cinematic edits, dislike performance-driven work, ignore briefs, take feedback personally or need constant supervision.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing e-commerce, direct-response, paid social, UGC or comparable advertising work

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut or a similar professional editing tool

- Working knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, music and basic colour correction

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and vertical video formats

- Professional written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection and availability for full-time remote work

- Ability to work within a structured workflow and meet deadlines consistently



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience editing Meta ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience working from performance data or iterating ads based on results

- After Effects, Photoshop, Figma or graphic-design ability

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Runway, Descript or similar

- Familiarity with Airtable, 
, Slack or comparable production tools

- Experience creating multiple hooks or variations from one core concept



WHAT WE OFFER



- Fully remote, long-term work with a growing international team

- Monthly compensation in USD, with the range based on experience and demonstrated ability

- Exposure to real e-commerce brands and creative that runs in live ad accounts

- The chance to see what actually performs, rather than editing in a results vacuum

- A clear path to grow into a senior editor, specialist editor or pod-lead position

title: Printer Technical Support Specialist
description:
About the Role

Barrister Global Services Network, Inc. is hiring a remote Printer Technical Support Specialist to guide our field Customer Engineers (CEs) through printer and copier repairs in real time. When a CE is on-site in front of a machine and cannot clear a fault, you are the expert they call.



This is not a general IT, helpdesk, or desktop/laptop support role. It is built for people with hands-on printer hardware repair experience.



• Location: Remote, open worldwide

• Employment type: Full-time

• Reports to: Technical Support Manager



Key Responsibilities

• Provide real-time phone and remote support to field CEs during printer diagnostics, repairs, part replacements, and installations.

• Troubleshoot hardware faults, print quality defects, error codes, paper jams, noise issues, and connectivity problems across multiple brands (HP, Lexmark, Xerox, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, and others).

• Use OEM service manuals to look up error codes, isolate failed components, and confirm the correct replacement parts.

• Walk CEs step by step through component-level work on fusers, drums, toner and imaging units, rollers, sensors, and feed assemblies.

• Act as the escalation point for complex or unresolved technical issues.

• Coordinate with manufacturers and vendors on advanced troubleshooting and case management.

• Monitor active service tickets so they are updated on time and properly documented.

• Keep repair reports, asset records, and case notes accurate.



Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of hands-on experience repairing printers, copiers, or multifunction devices, as a field technician, bench technician, or OEM technical support agent.

• Strong knowledge of printer hardware components and how they work together: fuser, drum, toner, transfer belt, rollers, sensors, and boards.

• Proven experience diagnosing hardware faults and replacing parts, not only software or driver issues.

• Able to read and apply OEM service manuals, error code tables, and parts catalogs.

• Hands-on experience with at least two major printer or copier brands.

• Experience supporting or working alongside field technicians or Customer Engineers.

• Familiar with ticketing systems and remote support tools.

• Clear, confident English, with the ability to guide someone through a repair under time pressure.

• Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet workspace.



Preferred Qualifications

• Manufacturer certifications (HP, Lexmark, Xerox, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, or similar).

• Experience with Canon, Ricoh, Sharp, or Brother devices.

• Experience handling warranty claims or vendor escalations.



Please Note

Applicants whose experience is limited to general IT support, desktop or laptop support, or service desk work will not be considered. In your application, describe your printer and copier repair experience specifically: brands, models, and the repairs you performed.

. You go through each video frame by frame, catch every mistake, and leave clear, timestamped notes so the editor can fix them fast.

What you'll do



Review every video the editors send through 
 before it goes to the client or gets posted

Dead space and awkward pauses

Stutters, filler words ("um," "uh," "like"), and false starts

Repeated words or repeated sentences

Bad cuts, jump-cut glitches, audio pops, and audio/caption mismatches

Captions that are off-sync, cut off, or covering important visuals

Review the structure of each video. Is the hook strong? Is the value clear? Is there a CTA?

Spot buried hooks. If the best line in the video is at 0:42, flag it and suggest moving it to the first 3 seconds

Suggest restructuring when a video drags, loses momentum, or buries the payoff

Leave clear, specific, timestamped notes in 
 (for example: "0:07 – remove stutter 'I-I think'" or "0:38 – this line is a stronger hook than the current opening. Move it to the start.")

What we're looking for (must-haves)



✅ Perfect written English. Not "good" and not "fluent." Perfect. You'll be the final check on English content, so your grammar, spelling, and punctuation have to be flawless.

✅ A real understanding of short-form content. You know what makes people stop scrolling, and you understand Hook → Value → CTA.

✅ You watch a lot of short-form content and can explain why a video works or doesn't

We are a rapidly growing e-commerce company specialising in consumer products within the children’s and health categories. We sell internationally through Amazon and are continuing to expand our product portfolio and develop innovative products that solve real customer problems.



We are looking for a highly proactive, commercially minded and driven Product Development Manager to take ownership of our product development pipeline, from identifying market opportunities to ensuring products are fully developed and ready for manufacturing.



This is not a passive research or coordination role. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, moves quickly, identifies opportunities independently and drives projects forward without waiting for instructions.



The Role



You will be responsible for identifying new product opportunities, understanding customer needs, developing product concepts, managing product development timelines and ensuring all requirements are completed before products move into production.



You will work closely with our sourcing and manufacturing team in China, graphic designers, quality control and management.



Your primary focus will be understanding the US and UK markets, identifying what customers need, developing differentiated products and ensuring products are developed efficiently and successfully.



Core Responsibilities



Market Research & Product Opportunity Identification



* Conduct market research to identify new product opportunities in the USA and UK.

* Analyse Amazon marketplaces, competitors, bestsellers and emerging trends.

* Identify market gaps, underserved customer needs and opportunities for product differentiation.

* Research competitors’ pricing, features, positioning and customer feedback.

* Evaluate product opportunities based on demand, competition, profitability and potential.

* Proactively present new product opportunities and recommendations.



Customer Research & Consumer Insights



* Analyse customer reviews across competing products.

* Identify recurring customer complaints, frustrations and unmet needs.

* Research customer discussions, forums, social media and other relevant platforms.

* Understand customer purchasing motivations and preferences.

* Translate customer insights into product improvements and new product concepts.

* Develop customer personas and product positioning based on actual research.



Product Concept Development



* Develop new product concepts based on market demand and customer insights.

* Identify product features, functionality, materials and design requirements.

* Develop product differentiation strategies.

* Improve existing products based on customer feedback and market research.

* Create detailed product development briefs.

* Ensure every product solves a genuine customer problem and has a clear competitive advantage.



Product Specifications & Development



* Create detailed product specifications, including dimensions, materials, features and functionality.

* Prepare clear product briefs for our China-based sourcing and manufacturing team.

* Coordinate product samples, revisions and approvals.

* Ensure product requirements are communicated clearly and accurately.

* Maintain product documentation and specification records.

* Ensure product development changes are documented and approved.



Packaging Development



* Develop packaging concepts and strategies.

* Determine packaging messaging, benefit hierarchy and product positioning.

* Write packaging copy and communicate key selling points.

* Prepare detailed packaging briefs for graphic designers.

* Review packaging designs and provide feedback.

* Ensure packaging effectively communicates the product’s value and differentiates it from competitors.

* Coordinate packaging artwork revisions, approval and final production files.



Product Development Project Management



* Own product development timelines and milestones.

* Create and maintain product development trackers.

* Ensure deadlines are established and followed.

* Track samples, specifications, packaging, testing and approvals.

* Proactively follow up with suppliers, designers and internal team members.

* Identify potential delays and bottlenecks before they affect timelines.

* Ensure all requirements are completed before products move into production.

* Maintain clear communication regarding project progress, risks and outstanding actions.



Testing, Compliance & Production Readiness



* Identify product testing and compliance requirements for relevant markets.

* Coordinate testing, certifications and documentation with relevant specialists.

* Ensure packaging and product requirements are incorporated into development.

* Coordinate sample testing and quality reviews.

* Maintain product development and production readiness checklists.

* Ensure all necessary documents, approvals and files are complete before mass production.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



* Work closely with our China-based sourcing and quality team.

* Coordinate with graphic designers on packaging and product visuals.

* Work with management on product opportunity evaluation and approval.

* Collaborate with our Amazon team to understand customer feedback, listing performance and market opportunities.

* Ensure all departments have the information and deadlines required to execute successfully.



What We Are Looking For



Essential



* Experience in physical consumer product development.

* Experience developing products for the US and/or UK markets.

* Strong market research and competitor analysis skills.

* Experience analysing customer reviews and identifying product opportunities.

* Experience developing product specifications and product briefs.

* Experience managing product development projects and timelines.

* Strong packaging development and product positioning skills.

* Excellent written and verbal English.

* Strong organisational and project management skills.

* Highly proactive, independent and commercially minded.

* Exceptional attention to detail.

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing e-commerce business.



Preferred



* Experience working with Amazon or e-commerce brands.

* Experience in children’s products, health products, household products or consumer goods.

* Experience working with manufacturers in China.

* Understanding of product testing and regulatory requirements for the USA and UK.

* Experience with AI tools for market research, analysis and workflow automation.

* Experience with product design, packaging or graphic design processes.



The Personality We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Takes ownership and does not wait to be told what to do.

* Moves quickly and gets things done.

* Is highly proactive and follows up consistently.

* Identifies problems before they become serious.

* Thinks commercially and strategically.

* Is resourceful and finds solutions.

* Has high standards and strong attention to detail.

* Communicates clearly and regularly.

* Is comfortable working independently.

* Is driven by results and enjoys building products and processes.



We do not want someone who simply completes assigned tasks. We want someone who takes ownership of projects and drives them forward.



What We Offer



* Fully Remote Position – Work from anywhere, with flexibility and autonomy to manage your work effectively.

* Healthcare & Dental Benefits – Healthcare and dental care benefits included as part of your employment package.

* Professional Development – Opportunities to develop your skills in product development, consumer research, market analysis, e-commerce, AI tools and project management.

* Career Growth – As our company continues to grow, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility, leadership and career progression.

* Meaningful Ownership – Take ownership of real product development projects and have a direct impact on the products we bring to market.

* International Exposure – Work with an international team and develop products for the USA, UK and European markets.

* Fast-Paced Environment – Work in an ambitious, growing company where initiative, efficiency and results are valued.

* Opportunity to Build – Help build and improve our product development processes as the company continues to scale.

* Competitive Compensation – Salary commensurate with experience, skills and demonstrated ability.

* Performance-Based Growth – Strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility as the business grows.



We value people who are ambitious, proactive, continuously learning and eager to make a meaningful contribution. We want our team members to grow alongside the company and develop skills that will strengthen their long-term careers.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



* Quality and commercial potential of product opportunities identified.

* Product development projects progressing efficiently.

* Product development timelines being met.

* Quality of customer and market research.

* Product differentiation and innovation.

* Accuracy and completeness of product specifications.

* Packaging quality and effectiveness.

* Proactive identification and resolution of bottlenecks.

* Products being ready for manufacturing with all required documentation and approvals.

* Ability to independently manage multiple product development projects.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV.

2. A summary of your experience developing physical consumer products.

3. Examples of products you have helped develop from concept to production.

4. Your experience with US and UK consumer markets.

5. Examples of product research, product specifications or packaging projects you have worked on, where possible.



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a practical product development assignment.



Please begin your application with the word “PRODUCT” so we know you have read the full job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, move fast and help build a growing international consumer brand.

title: Property Accountant (RCG Portfolio)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Property Accountant to join our team supporting the RCG Portfolio. In this role, you will oversee multi-entity property accounting, maintain accurate financial records, and manage tenant billing operations across commercial and multi-family real estate assets.



Working directly with AV Leads and Property Managers, you will ensure total ledger accuracy, execute timely bank reconciliations, manage lease financials, and deliver thorough month-end reporting packages tailored to RCG’s operational standards.



Key Responsibilities:



Property Accounting & Bookkeeping: 

Maintain accurate general ledgers across assigned properties and corporate entities. Execute daily cash management, monitor account balances, perform multi-account bank reconciliations, process AP/AR transactions, and drive month-end and year-end close routines (journal entries, accruals, prepaid schedules).



Tenant Management & Revenue Recovery: 

Oversee complex tenant recovery operations, including calculating and billing Common Area Maintenance (CAM), real estate tax reimbursements, and insurance/utility pass-throughs. Track security deposits, manage lease renewals, monitor delinquencies, and lead collection efforts.



Lease Financial Management & Abstracting: 

Review new and modified lease agreements to verify accounting system schedules against contractual terms. Maintain a centralized lease abstract database tracking key renewal dates, percentage rent clauses, CAM caps, and audit rights.



Portfolio Reporting & PM Support: 

Partner with Property and Asset Managers to deliver monthly financial reporting packages (Balance Sheets, Income Statements, Budget-vs.-Actual variance analyses), as well as compliance reports for lenders and investors.



Qualifications & Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Professional Experience: 3+ years in property accounting, real estate bookkeeping, or multi-entity financial management across commercial, retail, or multi-family real estate assets.



Software Proficiency: 

Hands-on experience with real estate accounting software (e.g., AppFolio, Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, or QuickBooks Online).



CAM & Tax Reconciliations: 

Proven expertise executing annual CAM, property tax, and insurance reconciliations for commercial tenants.

Advanced Excel & Analytical Skills: Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, financial modeling).



Communication & Remote Work Style: 

Exceptional written and spoken English, meticulous attention to detail, and a self-motivated ability to independently manage multi-property deadlines during monthly close cycles.

title: Short-form Video Editor for Tahanan
description:
Tahanan is a guided, human-made Tagalog learning app that helps learners reconnect with Filipino language, family, and culture. We make short, approachable lessons, and we carry that human-made approach into every video we publish.



You’ll work directly with Hana, Tahanan’s creative director. She’ll provide the scripts, voiceovers, and creative direction, and she’ll review and approve each edit. You’ll turn those materials into a steady stream of short videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



Our editing style is simple and intentional. Think clean cuts, easy-to-read captions, and still illustrations timed to the voiceover. When an illustration needs movement, we use manually sequenced poses for a stop-motion effect. We’re looking for someone who can keep that style consistent across a high volume of videos and turn around edits and revisions quickly.



What you’ll do

Edit vertical videos using Hana’s scripts, voiceovers, clips, illustrations, and brand assets.

Turn around edits and revisions on agreed timelines.



Keep project files and exports organized for easy handoff.



Flag missing assets or suggest improvements for Hana’s review.



What we’re looking for

Experience editing short-form videos in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or a similar editor.



Good timing, readable captions, and attention to visual consistency.



The ability to follow creative direction and deliver a steady volume of edits.



Clear communication about turnaround times, availability, and revisions.



Understanding Tagalog is a plus.



Human-made production is required

Generative AI is prohibited in both the application sample and paid work. This includes AI-generated or AI-modified visuals, animation, voiceovers, music, and other content in the edit.



Never upload Tahanan’s assets to a generative AI tool or use one to alter or animate them. This applies to Kuya Lumpia illustrations, logos, voiceovers, and other materials we share. Use standard editing tools and sequence the supplied poses manually if you want to show movement. Applications that violate this requirement will be disqualified.

Create one vertical sample edit, 15–45 seconds long, using the raw voiceover and assets in Tahanan Video Editor Applicant Packet.

title: Planning & Forecast Analyst
description:
About the Role



We’re hiring a Planning & Forecast Analyst to own our OTB (Open-to-Buy) Planner, a forecasting model we built in Claude, and turn its SKU-level forecasts into monthly replenishment buys the team can trust for DTC and Amazon.



The model went live about three weeks ago. It produces the numbers. Your job is to make sure they are right, explain what they mean, and improve the logic as we learn where it works and where it misses.



This role is half analyst, half model builder. You review every cycle’s output and challenge outliers, then build and ship the logic changes yourself in Claude.



What makes this hard: Many of our SKUs launch strong and then fade quickly, which makes demand hard to predict. A simple run-rate forecast over-buys on fading items and under-buys on new hits. Your job is to model those launch-and-fade patterns and keep the buy right across the whole assortment.



Mission: A monthly replenishment buy the team trusts, with fewer stockouts on what sells and less cash tied up in what doesn’t.



Who we’re looking for: A strong quantitative thinker who is good with math and models. Retail planning experience helps but isn’t required. We’ll teach you the planning process.



Work Setup



Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Location: Remote

Timezone: US Eastern Time (EST). You need to work during our business hours.

Rate: USD 12–15 per hour, depending on experience

Works with: Merchandising, ecommerce and Amazon teams. Model changes are signed off by our planning lead.



Key Responsibilities



Own the Monthly Replenishment Cycle



Run the OTB Planner each month and prepare the recommended replenishment buy for DTC and Amazon

Review SKU-level forecasts line by line before they become purchase orders (POs), and flag and resolve outliers

Reconcile the SKU-level buy back to the OTB dollar plan by channel, category and month



Work the Data



Separate DTC and Amazon demand drivers: promotions, traffic, Amazon in-stock and FBA constraints, seasonality and gifting peaks

Spot at-risk SKUs early: projected stockouts, overstock and slow movers

Build simple, repeatable views that show the buy, the risks and what changed since last month



Build and Own the Model Logic



Model launch-and-fade curves: how fast new SKUs ramp, when they peak and when to stop rebuying

Design and build logic updates backed by evidence (e.g. seasonality weights, safety stock, lead times, new-item and end-of-life rules, channel splits)

Back-test every change against recent history, get sign-off, roll it out, and roll it back if it underperforms

Version and document every logic change so the team always knows what the model is doing and why



Communicate



Present the monthly buy recommendation with a short read on risks and changes

Answer “Why is the model saying this?” for merchandising, ecommerce and Amazon partners



Claude Skills Are Core to This Role



The OTB Planner was built in Claude and lives there. Changing the model means working in Claude directly, not filing a request with IT. Claude expertise is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have.



In practice, that means:



Writing the logic: Clear, precise instructions that define how the model forecasts and buys

Setting up the data: Structuring the DTC and Amazon sales, inventory and OTB inputs the model runs on

Checking the output: Testing Claude’s results against the source data instead of trusting them, and catching errors before they reach a PO



Example of the work: The model over-forecasts new items on Amazon. You spot it in the weekly review, rebuild the new-item ramp rule in Claude, back-test it on the last three months, and ship it before the next buy.



Operating Rhythm



The role runs on two clocks: a weekly model review and a monthly replenishment buy.



Every week: Model review

You lead the weekly review of the OTB Planner. You look at what sold versus forecast for DTC and Amazon, which SKUs the model is missing, and which logic changes to test or ship next.



Every month: The replenishment buy (timing aligned with our PO calendar)



Week 1, close and review: Load last month’s actuals, measure forecast accuracy by SKU and channel, and log misses and their causes

Week 2, run and scrub: Refresh the OTB Planner, review the SKU-level forecasts for DTC and Amazon, and resolve outliers with partners

Week 3, recommend and buy: Reconcile the buy to OTB, present the recommendation, then finalize and hand off POs

Week 4, improve: Roll up the weekly reviews and ship the logic changes the month taught us before the next run



Requirements



Strong quantitative and analytical skills, comfortable with math, statistics and forecasting models

Hands-on experience using Claude (or a similar AI tool) to build and refine logic, with a habit of checking AI output against source data

Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills

Experience structuring and cleaning sales and inventory data

Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain what a model is doing to non-technical partners

Detail-oriented. You catch errors before they become purchase orders



Nice to Have



Retail, ecommerce or inventory planning experience (OTB, replenishment, demand planning)

Amazon seller experience, especially FBA inventory and in-stock management

Experience with back-testing and forecast accuracy metrics

Experience forecasting short-lifecycle or trend-driven products

title: UGC Creator & Influencer Coordinator
description:

What if the creators you recruit today become the faces behind our next winning advertisements?

At Enclave BioActives, we're looking for a driven and resourceful UGC Creator & Influencer Coordinator who wants to do more than manage creator collaborations. We want someone who can build a powerful creator network, bring fresh creative talent into our brands, and help fuel the growth of our marketing campaigns.

As we continue expanding our brands, we need a consistent pipeline of talented creators who can produce authentic, engaging, and conversion-focused content. That's where you come in.

You will take ownership of the creator acquisition and management process—from discovering promising talent and building relationships to coordinating content production and securing advertising permissions.

If you're someone who loves building relationships, making things happen, and seeing the direct results of your work, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.



What You'll Bring



Proven experience recruiting and managing UGC creators and/or influencers for consumer brands.

Strong understanding of the complete UGC workflow, from sourcing and outreach to briefing, production, revisions, and final delivery.

A strong eye for identifying creators who can produce authentic, engaging, and compelling direct-response content.

Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

Ability to manage multiple creators, collaborations, and content projects without losing track of priorities.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently drive projects forward.

A proactive, ownership-driven attitude with a genuine interest in creative performance and marketing.



How You'll Make an Impact



1. Build a Creator Network That Becomes a Growth Asset

Discover and recruit UGC creators, influencers, and TikTok creators who align with our brands, products, and target audiences.

Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified creators for continuous content production.

Identify new creator segments and sourcing opportunities that can expand our reach and creative possibilities.

Build long-term relationships with reliable creators who can become recurring brand partners.

Your impact: Build a dependable creator ecosystem that gives our brands continuous access to fresh talent and creative opportunities.



2. Turn Creator Partnerships Into High-Quality Content

Manage the end-to-end creator collaboration process, from initial outreach and recruitment to final content delivery.

Coordinate creative briefs, product shipments, deadlines, revisions, approvals, and deliverables.

Evaluate creators based on content quality, authenticity, communication, audience fit, and potential to produce effective advertising assets.

Negotiate creator rates, deliverables, usage rights, and collaboration terms.

Maintain strong relationships that encourage repeat collaborations and consistent content production.

Your impact: Ensure our creative team receives a steady supply of quality UGC without unnecessary delays or production bottlenecks.



3. Help Power Our Winning Advertising Creatives

Collaborate with Creative Strategists and Media Buyers to understand the creators, content styles, and messaging angles needed for upcoming campaigns.

Source creators who can effectively communicate product benefits, address customer pain points, and create compelling content.

Support the production of creator-led advertisements designed for creative testing and paid media campaigns.

Coordinate Meta whitelisting and Partnership Ads, ensuring all necessary creator authorizations are secured.

Recruit and manage TikTok Shop creators and affiliates to support creator-led content and affiliate initiatives.

Your impact: Help our team test more creative concepts, explore new advertising opportunities, and develop content with the potential to become winning ads.



4. Protect Our Brand and Creator Partnerships

Negotiate creator compensation, deliverables, usage rights, and advertising permissions.

Secure the necessary content usage rights and creator authorizations before assets are used in campaigns.

Coordinate creator agreements and ensure collaboration terms are clearly documented.

Your impact: Give our team confidence that the content we produce is properly authorized and ready for marketing use.



5. Build Systems That Can Scale With the Business

Identify opportunities to improve creator sourcing, outreach, onboarding, and production workflows.

Track recruitment activity, creator responsiveness, content delivery, and relevant campaign indicators.

Identify high-quality creators who are worth developing into long-term brand partners.

Continuously improve the creator pipeline to support increasing creative production demands across our brands.

Your impact: Help transform creator recruitment from a series of individual collaborations into a repeatable, scalable growth system.



Why Join Enclave BioActives?



Make an Impact That Goes Beyond Your Job Title.

Own Something Meaningful: Take the lead in building and developing a creator network that becomes an important asset to our business.

See the Results of Your Work: Your recruitment efforts will directly contribute to the creative content our brands use to reach and convert customers.



Who Will Thrive in This Role?



This opportunity is ideal for someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do.

You enjoy finding great talent, building relationships, negotiating partnerships, and making sure projects get done. You understand that great UGC can be more than engaging content—it can become a powerful advertising asset that helps a business grow.



We're not simply looking for someone to coordinate creators. We're looking for someone who can build the creator network, systems, and partnerships that help drive our next stage of growth.

title: SEO Content Specialist (Research, Writing and Publishing)
description:
Botanopia makes modern gifts and cards for plant lovers. About 1,200 independent shops in Europe and the US stock them. Our website is where those shops, their customers, and anyone who typed a question into Google d
 whether we're worth their time.



Some of what we published years ago needs a second look. There's plenty we haven't written yet. You'll do both.



WHAT YOU OWN



You own how Botanopia shows up in search. You d
 what to write, you write it, you publish it.



- Find the topics worth writing about, based on what people actually search for.

- Draft with AI, then rewrite until it reads like someone who knows the subject.

- Check every fact. If you can't source it, it doesn't go up.

- Choose the pictures for each article from our library of original photography.

- Publish in WordPress, so each article looks like it belongs on our site. (no worries if you only know other platforms, we'll train you).

- Go back to older articles and update them. Then track how the updated ones perform compared with the new ones, so we know where the effort pays off.

- When an article performs, localize it for French, German and Dutch. That means AI where it helps, plus checking which keywords people actually search in each language, because they aren't always a translation of the English one. A native speaker checks the result when possible.



You report to our Head of Marketing and work closely with me, the founder.



THE BAR



Every article is correct, useful, and good enough to carry our name, because it does. Whoever lands on it, whether a shop owner, a plant lover or a stranger from Google, should leave knowing something they didn't. We would rather publish one piece we're proud of than five we aren't. We're not building a content farm.



We set output goals together in your first weeks, based on how long good work actually takes. Volume never beats quality.



HOW WE WORK



Everyone on the team uses time tracking software, you included. Yes, it's a clock. That's the point: it tells us whether a task was worth the hours. A few months in, we look at it together and d
 what to keep doing, what to drop, and what to automate or hand off.



We judge you on results and agreed goals. You'll check in with our Head of Marketing every day in your first weeks, so we need 2 to 3 hours a day that overlap with Amsterdam time (CET). Pick the shift that works for you. The rest of your hours are yours to arrange.



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- You want a keyword list and a word count handed to you each morning.

- You publish whatever the AI gives you.

- You don't care how a page looks.



WHAT WE OFFER



- 20 days paid time off a year

- A channel that's yours, with clear goals and a Head of Marketing to train you and answers your questions



HOW TO APPLY



 
 with maplemoth11 in the subject line. 



Answer all three in the body of your
. 



1. Links to two or three articles you wrote that are live, and what you would change in each now.

2. You use AI to draft. What do you check before anything goes live, and what does AI regularly get wrong?

3. Pick one page on 
. What would you do to it? Two or three sentences is enough.
