title: Senior Customer Support Representative (Philippines)
description:
Senior Customer Support Representative (Philippines)

 

Company: Keylr (Key Riders Ltd), London Location: Philippines – 100% remote / work from home Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time (40 hrs/week) Hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time (17:00–02:00 Manila during UK winter / 16:00–01:00 during UK summer time) Reports to: Customer Support & Onboarding Supervisor (Philippines)



About Keylr



Keylr is a fast-growing London B2B marketplace connecting property managers, estate agents and short-term rental operators with verified local trade suppliers – plumbers, electricians, locksmiths, cleaners, handymen and more. A client raises a maintenance request, we match it to a vetted supplier, and we make sure the job gets done.



The Role



You are on the front line for both sides of the marketplace. You pick up the phone to property managers with urgent repairs, help suppliers get set up and compliant, and keep jobs moving from request to completion. As a senior member of the team you handle the harder calls, follow our SOPs to the letter and help the supervisor improve them.



Key Responsibilities



1. Inbound support – clients and suppliers

Answer inbound calls,
s and tickets from property managers and suppliers during UK business hours

Resolve queries on job status, quotes, invoices, payments and platform access

Handle urgent and emergency jobs calmly; escalate supplier no-shows and complaints to the supervisor with full notes

Log every interaction accurately in the helpdesk/CRM

2. Supplier onboarding & document checking

Call new supplier applicants and guide them through profile set-up on the Keylr platform

Check Public Liability Insurance (cover and expiry), trade certifications, company/VAT and bank details against our checklist

Chase missing or expired documents by phone and
 until the supplier is fully compliant

3. Dispatch support

Monitor the job queue and call panel suppliers to offer and fill unallocated jobs at the agreed rate card

Follow up on attendance, status updates and job completion

Re-allocate quickly when a supplier drops out

4. Quality & team support

Follow SOPs and scripts; flag gaps and suggest improvements

Help draft canned responses and FAQ articles

Support and shadow-train new junior agents as the team grows



Requirements



Must have



2+ years in a customer service, contact centre or dispatch role, ideally voice-based

Experience supporting UK or other Western clients

Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent

Confident making outbound calls – polite but persistent with busy tradespeople

Strong attention to detail when checking documents

Comfortable with helpdesk/CRM tools (e.g. Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot) and cloud phone systems (e.g. Aircall, RingCentral)

Able to work the full UK-hours shift consistently, Monday to Friday



Nice to have



Background in property management, facilities, home services, logistics or a marketplace (e.g. Grab, foodpanda, Lalamove)

Experience with property maintenance software (Fixflo, Reapit, Arthur or similar)

Experience checking supplier or contractor documents



Equipment & Home Office Requirements



As an independent contractor you provide your own equipment and workspace:

Laptop or desktop: Intel i5 / Ryzen 5 or better, 8 GB RAM minimum, Windows 10/11 or macOS

USB noise-cancelling headset with microphone (e.g. Jabra, Logitech, Poly) – mandatory

Fibre internet, minimum 50 Mbps

Backup internet (second ISP or mobile data/pocket Wi-Fi)

UPS or power backup

Quiet, dedicated workspace free from background noise

Webcam for video meetings



What We Offer



Monthly base fee: PHP 30,000

Onboarding &  performance bonus: performance bonus of 20% when 100% onboarding and fulfilment is achieved  (all required documents verified and approved by Keylr)



Monday–Friday fixed schedule, weekends off

100% remote



Growth path into team lead as the Philippines team expands



How to Apply



Send all three of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



1. CV showing your customer service or dispatch experience and any UK client work

2. Voice recording (1–2 minutes) via Vocaroo, Loom, Google Drive or an MP3 link, answering: "Introduce yourself, describe your customer service experience, and explain how you would handle a property manager calling about a supplier who hasn't turned up to fix a leak."

3.Two professional references, at least one a former direct supervisor (name, title, company,
)



Hiring Process



Application screening: CV, voice recording and references

First interview (30 min, video): experience, English and a short role-play call

Practical task (30 min): reply to a client
 about a delayed job, and write a short call script to chase a supplier for missing insurance

Final interview with the Supervisor and CEO

Reference checks and contract

The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with the expectation this grows to full-time reasonably quickly as more tasks are handed over. title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based VAs only)

Read this whole thing before you apply. If you skim it, you'll fail step one.

 

Smartland manages 2000+ rental homes and apartments. The CEO moves fast and d
 faster. This role exists to make him faster still: to remove friction, anticipate the next three steps, and never let a ball drop. You are his memory, his logic check, and his second brain.

 

This is not a calendar-and-coffee job. If that's what you're looking for, stop here.

 

MANDATORY EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENT – READ CAREFULLY

We will only consider candidates who have at least three (3) consecutive years of experience working directly as an Executive Assistant to the same CEO at the same company.

 

To qualify:

You must have supported the same CEO for at least three consecutive years.

All three years of experience must have been with one company and one CEO.

Experience accumulated by working for different CEOs or across multiple companies will not count toward this requirement.

Your role must have involved direct, ongoing support to the CEO, not simply administrative support to a department, manager, or other executive.

If you do not meet all these requirements, please do not apply. Applicants who do not meet this qualification will not be considered for the position.

 

What You'll Actually Do:

Run the CEO's day so he doesn't have to think about logistics: calendar, travel, prep, follow-through.

Catch things before they become problems.

We expect you to flag what we missed. Hold the full picture in your head: who owes what, what's due when, which thread is still open.

Turn vague direction into a finished result without being walked through it.

Build and maintain checklists for everything, because nothing falls through a good checklist.



Who We're Looking For:

You think fast and you think clearly. Sloppy logic is a dealbreaker.

Your memory is sharp. People are surprised by what you remember.

You're relentlessly organized. You love checklists, genuinely, not as a line on a résumé.

You're proactive. You'd rather ask forgiveness than wait for instructions on the obvious.

You think strategically. You see why a task matters, not just what the task is.

When the standard template doesn't fit, you build a better one.



Do Not Apply If:

You need detailed instructions to start.

You've ever said, "That's not my job."

You drop tasks and blame the volume.

You're hoping to wing it. We will find out by week one.

A significant portion of your working hours will need to overlap with Australian business hours as you will be speaking directly with Australian businesses and organisations.

You will work across several different brands and campaigns, so the role is varied and there is always something new to work on.



One day you might be contacting shopping centres about entertainment and activations.



Another day you may be speaking with councils, venues, businesses, sponsors, clubs or corporate organisations about one of our other services or projects.

Researching prospective clients and organisations

Helping create prospect lists for new services and brands

Keeping track of follow-ups so opportunities are not forgotten

Reporting on calls, contacts, leads and opportunities generated

THIS IS ABOUT OPENING DOORS



We are not expecting you to close large contracts on the first telephone call.



Your goal is to get us past:



"Who do I need to speak to?"



and move us towards:



"Yes, please send me some information."



or even better:



"That sounds interesting. Let's organise a meeting."



You will be the person who creates the beginning of that relationship.



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO IS PROACTIVE



We don't want to hand you 100 phone numbers and simply ask you to call them.



We want someone who can also think:



"Who else could buy this?"



"What other companies should we approach?"



"Who is the right person inside this organisation?"



"They aren't interested now, but when should I contact them again?"



"I noticed this company has an event coming up — should we approach them?"



We want someone who enjoys finding opportunities and building a pipeline.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

Speak excellent, confident English

Are comfortable talking to Australian businesses

Have a friendly and natural telephone manner

Are persuasive without being pushy

Don't get discouraged by hearing "no"

Can build rapport quickly

Are organised and reliable

Have excellent attention to detail

Can research businesses independently

Are confident using Google, LinkedIn and online directories

Can maintain databases accurately

Write professional emails

Follow up without needing to be constantly reminded

Can manage several different campaigns at once

Are comfortable working independently

Take initiative and look for opportunities



Previous experience in business development, appointment setting, outbound calling, lead generation, sales, virtual assistance or CRM/database management would be highly regarded.



Experience speaking with Australian, UK or US customers would also be an advantage.



THIS IS NOT A CALL-CENTRE ROLE



We care much more about quality conversations than simply hitting a ridiculous number of calls per hour.



We want our prospective clients to have a positive first impression of our businesses.



You should sound like part of our team — not like somebody reading from a script in a call centre.



There will be targets and accountability, but we will be looking at outcomes including:



Decision-makers identified

Genuine conversations

Information packs requested

Qualified leads generated

Follow-ups created

Meetings generated

Database growth

New opportunities uncovered

New clients generated

OPPORTUNITY TO GROW



Our businesses continue to expand and new projects are regularly being launched.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity to grow with us and become an important part of our business development and sales team, with the potential for additional hours, increased pay and greater responsibility in the future.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



A short introduction about yourself

Details of your previous outbound calling or business development experience

Any experience calling Australian businesses

The types of clients or industries you have previously contacted

CRM/database systems you have used

Your availability and the hours you can work

Confirmation that you are comfortable with the starting rate of USD $5.50 per hour + performance bonuses

A short voice recording introducing yourself as though you were calling a prospective Australian client



And finally, tell us:



If we gave you a new service tomorrow and asked you to find 100 Australian businesses that might buy it, how would you approach the task?



We are looking for someone confident, resourceful and proactive who can become a genuine part of our growing team.



Please do not apply without including the requested voice recording.

title: Meta Ads Growth Partner – U.S. Home Improvement Company
description:
$400 Guaranteed Monthly Minimum + Performance Commissions





About the Opportunity:



Hill Country Turf Co. is a newly launched artificial turf installation company serving homeowners throughout San Antonio, Texas, and the surrounding communities. We help homeowners transform ordinary backyards into beautiful, low-maintenance outdoor spaces for families, pets, entertaining, and everyday living. 



We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Meta advertising specialist to help build our residential lead-generation program from the ground up.



This is not a traditional social media management position.



We're not looking for someone to schedule content, grow our follower count, or simply manage an advertising budget.



We're looking for someone who knows how to create compelling
 and Instagram advertisements, generate qualified homeowner inquiries, and turn advertising into measurable business opportunities.



Most importantly, we want someone who sees the potential to earn considerably more than a traditional fixed monthly salary by producing results.





Why This Opportunity Is Different:



Our expected average residential installation is approximately $10,000, although actual project values will vary considerably.

Some projects may be smaller, while larger backyard transformations, premium installations, and properties requiring extensive turf work could represent $20,000, $30,000, $40,000, or more.



We're especially interested in attracting higher-value residential projects. A single $40,000 installation can generate substantially more commission income than several smaller installations. Rather than paying a flat monthly salary regardless of results, we've structured this opportunity to reward the person responsible for helping us grow. You'll receive guaranteed monthly compensation, plus the opportunity to earn considerably more through performance-based commissions.



Our goal is to establish a long-term relationship with someone who wants to help build the business, improve advertising performance, and share financially in the success they help create.





Guaranteed minimum compensation: 



$400 USD per month. You will receive at least $400 per month for fulfilling your agreed responsibilities, even if earned commissions are lower. Your guaranteed monthly payment is credited toward your commissions for that same month. You receive whichever is greater: your $400 monthly guarantee or your earned commissions. The monthly guarantee resets each month. You will never owe the company money if commissions are below $400.





Commission Structure:



Commissions are calculated on qualifying installation revenue actually collected from customers generated through your advertising campaigns.



2% on the first $50,000 of qualifying monthly revenue.



3% on incremental qualifying revenue between $50,000 and $100,000.



4% on incremental qualifying revenue above $100,000.



Higher commission tiers depend on meeting agreed advertising-efficiency standards. Commissions and revenue thresholds will be defined in a written agreement.





What Could You Earn?:



Assuming completed installations are attributable to your advertising:



Closed Installations                                Installation Revenue           Your Potential Monthly Compensation



0–2 jobs averaging $10K                       $0–$20,000                          $400 guaranteed minimum



3 jobs averaging $10K                            $30,000                                $600



5 jobs averaging $10K                            $50,000                                $1,000



10 jobs averaging $10K                          $100,000                              $2,500



3 high-value jobs averaging $40K         $120,000                              $3,300



15 jobs averaging $10K                         $150,000                               $4,500



Examples assume all qualifying installation revenue is collected within the same monthly measurement period and commission accelerator requirements are satisfied. These figures illustrate potential earnings, not guaranteed results.



Consider the opportunity of generating just three $40,000 installation projects. That represents $120,000 in revenue. Under the proposed commission structure, you could earn $3,300 from those three customers alone.



This is why we're not simply trying to generate the highest possible number of inexpensive leads. We want to attract serious homeowners with valuable projects, strong purchasing intent, and the financial ability to invest in professional installations.



There is no predetermined maximum commission.



You are not responsible for personally selling or installing the turf. Your primary responsibility is generating qualified opportunities. HCTC handles customer consultations, onsite estimates, proposals, sales, and installation.





Our Expected Closing Rate:



Our target is to close approximately 25–35% of completed, qualified onsite estimates. This is a planning target, not a guaranteed historical conversion rate. As a new business, we will measure and refine our actual performance. We recognize that closing performance is a shared responsibility. HCTC is responsible for responding to customers promptly, providing professional estimates, following up, and converting opportunities into signed installations.



However, the quality of the leads you generate also has a substantial influence on closing rates. A homeowner actively considering a $30,000 backyard transformation is a different prospect from someone casually clicking an advertisement without understanding the potential installation cost.



For example:

Generating three closed installations at a 25–35% closing rate would generally require approximately 9–12 completed qualified onsite estimates.



Generating five closed installations would generally require approximately 15–20 completed qualified onsite estimates. Generating ten closed installations would generally require approximately 29–40 completed qualified onsite estimates. These estimates illustrate the relationship between qualified opportunities and completed sales. Actual results will vary.



Our priority is attracting homeowners who have real projects, realistic budgets, and strong intentions to move forward. HCTC funds all approved Meta advertising expenses separately. You are never expected to fund advertising from your own compensation.





Your Responsibilities:



1. Create Our Advertising Content



We're a new company, and we don't yet have a portfolio of completed installations.



You'll be responsible for building our initial advertising creative independently.



This includes:



Finding high-quality artificial turf photos and video footage with appropriate commercial usage rights OR using AI image-generation tools to create photorealistic backyard transformations and landscaping concepts when suitable original imagery is unavailable.



Creating professional
 and Instagram advertisements.



Editing compelling short-form videos and Reels.



Producing static advertisements, graphics, and visual concepts.



Writing engaging hooks, headlines, captions, and calls to action.



Developing new advertising concepts based on performance.



AI-generated imagery is absolutely welcome.



We're particularly interested in candidates who can produce convincing, photorealistic images of residential backyards, artificial turf installations, pet areas, and outdoor living spaces.



These visuals should look like authentic residential photography, with realistic lighting, landscaping, materials, proportions, and details—not obvious AI-generated artwork.



The objective is to help homeowners picture what their own property could become.



All advertising must accurately represent HCTC's capabilities. AI-generated concepts must not be presented as photographs of completed HCTC projects, and other companies' installations must not be misrepresented as our own. Concept renderings should be identified appropriately.



We'll provide our company branding, business information, and strategic direction.





2. Build and Manage Meta Advertising Campaigns



You'll be responsible for:



Setting up and managing
 and Instagram lead-generation campaigns.



Researching residential audiences and customer needs.



Developing and testing offers, messaging, and advertising creative.



Identifying opportunities to reach homeowners considering larger, premium outdoor transformations.



Managing campaigns within approved advertising budgets.



Monitoring lead costs and campaign performance.



Improving advertising efficiency through ongoing testing and optimization.



Developing recommendations for scaling successful campaigns.



We expect you to understand the difference between increasing advertising spend and actually improving performance.



Additional budget must be justified through results and a clear explanation of how the additional spending will create value.





3. Generate Qualified, High-Value Residential Leads



Our goal is to generate legitimate homeowner inquiries for residential artificial turf installations.



We're particularly interested in customers seeking:



Complete backyard transformations and lawn replacements.



Larger residential turf installations.



Premium outdoor living and landscape improvements.



Pet-friendly artificial turf.



Low-maintenance residential landscaping.



Family recreation areas and outdoor entertainment spaces.



Residential putting greens and specialty turf applications.



Our initial geographic focus is the San Antonio–New Braunfels market in Texas.



While the average installation is expected to be approximately $10,000, we want to actively pursue opportunities for larger projects.



Your goal is not simply to minimize cost per lead. It's to find the right homeowners and generate the greatest amount of profitable installation revenue possible.



A campaign that produces three highly qualified $40,000 projects could be considerably more valuable than one that produces dozens of small or unqualified inquiries.



You'll help develop lead forms, messaging, and targeting strategies that attract homeowners with realistic expectations and genuine interest in professional installation.



4. Track Results and Improve Performance



We believe the best marketers understand what happens after someone submits a lead form.



You'll work with HCTC's lead-tracking system to monitor:



Advertising expenditures.



Customer inquiries.



Qualified leads.



Scheduled and completed onsite estimates.



Estimated project values.



Signed installation contracts.



Attributable installation revenue.



Cost per qualified estimate and customer acquisition.



Revenue and customer acquisition efficiency by campaign.



You'll provide a concise weekly performance report explaining what worked, what didn't, and what you recommend changing.



HCTC will maintain responsibility for customer follow-up, estimating, and closing. You'll receive appropriate visibility into lead outcomes so your commission earnings can be verified.





Who We're Looking for - Required qualifications:



Proven experience managing Meta advertising for U.S. businesses.



Demonstrated ability to generate qualified customer leads.



Strong graphic design and short-form video editing skills.



Excellent direct-response advertising and copywriting abilities.



Ability to source appropriate visuals or produce professional, photorealistic AI-generated advertising concepts.



Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and conversion tracking.



Ability to work independently with limited supervision.



Strong written English and professional communication.



A performance-oriented mindset and sound judgment about advertising expenditures.





Preferred experience:



We'd particularly like to hear from candidates who have run campaigns for:



Landscaping companies.



Artificial turf installers.



Swimming pool builders.



Roofing contractors.



Home remodeling businesses.



Outdoor living and luxury backyard contractors.



Other residential home-improvement companies.



Experience advertising higher-ticket services to American homeowners is especially valuable.



You don't need previous artificial turf experience if you have demonstrated success in a comparable industry.





Working Arrangement:



Fully remote from the Philippines.



Approximately 8–12 hours per week initially, though this is a performance based job - if working more helps generate more leads, you make more money.



Some availability during U.S. Central Time for weekly meetings.



Initial 90-day engagement, with long-term potential.



Direct communication with the business owner.



Guaranteed $400 monthly minimum with performance-based commission upside.



We're interested in developing a sustainable relationship with someone who becomes increasingly valuable as the company grows.



If our advertising program expands significantly, we'll revisit responsibilities, workload, and the working arrangement accordingly.





How to Apply:



Please begin your application with the words "HCTC Growth Partner."



We want to understand what you've actually accomplished—not simply read a list of software you know how to use.



Please include the following:



1. Previous results



Describe your most successful Meta lead-generation campaign for a U.S. business.



Include the industry, approximate advertising spend, number of leads, cost per lead, qualified appointments (if tracked), and your personal responsibilities.



2. Creative portfolio



Provide three examples of
 or Instagram advertisements you personally created.



We would especially like to see short-form videos, photorealistic AI-generated advertising concepts, lead forms that qualify or rank customer profitability and closing likelihood, or advertisements designed to generate customer inquiries.



3. Relevant experience



Have you advertised for home-improvement, landscaping, roofing, remodeling, or similar businesses? Tell us about your most relevant experience.



4. Creating advertising from scratch



HCTC currently has no completed installation photographs or videos.



Explain how you would create professional advertisements for our business using properly licensed source materials, original creative concepts, or photorealistic AI-generated imagery.



Which AI tools, if any, would you use?



5. Advertising judgment



Imagine you spend $500 on Meta advertising and generate 18 leads, but only four are qualified and just one schedules an onsite estimate.



What would you investigate before asking us to increase the advertising budget?



6. High-value customer acquisition



If you were responsible for attracting homeowners considering $20,000–$40,000 backyard transformations rather than smaller turf installations, how would your advertising strategy differ?



7. Your availability



Tell us your current time zone, approximate weekly availability, and whether you're comfortable with our guaranteed minimum and performance-based commission structure.



IMPORTANT: APPLICANTS THAT DO NOT REPSOND TO ALL 7 OF THE INITIAL INQUIRY QUESTIONS ABOVE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.





Our Selection Process:



We'll review applicants based on demonstrated results, creative quality, analytical judgment, and their ability to work independently.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview and may be asked to complete a separately compensated creative and advertising assessment.



We are not looking for the cheapest person who knows how to run
 ads.



We're looking for someone talented enough to build a highly profitable customer-acquisition program - and ambitious enough to want to be rewarded for doing it.



If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

title: HR Generalist I (HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Recruitment Marketing)
description:
PLEASE APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: 
/apply-job-1



About us:



With over 100 years of combined industry experience, the Community Minerals team specializes in the purchase of mineral or royalty rights all over the US. We have earned a stellar reputation with hundreds of satisfied customers and an “A” Rating with the Better Business Bureau. With our proven track record, we continue to serve mineral owners in several states with transparency, accountability, and a personalized experience to meet individual needs.



Job Summary:



The HR Generalist I provides operational and administrative support across HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Recruitment Marketing. This role is responsible for coordinating and executing essential HR processes throughout the contractor lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding to regularization and offboarding.



The position ensures the accuracy and timely maintenance of HR records, recruitment databases, documentation, and reports while supporting recruitment initiatives, candidate engagement, and employer branding activities.



The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities while collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient People & Culture operations.





Key Responsibilities:



A. HR OPERATIONS:



1. Onboarding Coordination

• Maintain and update onboarding trackers, HRIS tools, and contractor documentation folders.

• Coordinate onboarding schedules, reminders, IT access requests, and payroll notifications.

• Ensure proper completion, organization, and filing of contractor documentation and 201 files.

• Conduct post-training updates and facilitate onboarding surveys.

• Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new contractors.



2. Regularization Management

• Monitor and update regularization trackers, checklists, and supporting documentation.

• Coordinate the submission of KPIs, behavioral assessments, and performance evaluations.

• Prepare regularization letters and process contractor status updates in HRIS.

• Follow up with supervisors and department heads on pending evaluations and requirements.



3. Healthcare Bonus Administration

• Monitor healthcare bonus eligibility and maintain accurate tracking records.

• Maintain supporting documentation related to healthcare bonus administration.

• Coordinate with Payroll regarding healthcare bonus processing and updates.

• Respond to contractor inquiries regarding healthcare bonus eligibility, requirements, and processing.



4. Offboarding Coordination

• Process contractor resignations and terminations in a timely manner.

• Coordinate completion of offboarding checklists and ensure proper documentation and filing.

• Facilitate necessary system access deactivation requests with IT.

• Coordinate with Payroll to facilitate the timely processing and release of final pay.

• Update contractor records and HRIS information to reflect offboarding status.



5. Documentation and Reporting

• Maintain accurate and updated HR trackers, HRIS records, and contractor 201 files.

• Conduct regular documentation and file audits to ensure accuracy and compliance with internal policies.

• Prepare weekly and monthly HR Operations reports covering activities, pending items, blockers, and ongoing initiatives.

• Ensure proper documentation and confidentiality of contractor information.



6. Cross-Functional Support

• Coordinate with IT, Payroll, Training, and Department Heads on HR-related requirements.

• Respond to general HR inquiries and escalate concerns requiring further review or approval.

• Support HR projects, process improvements, job fairs, and other People & Culture initiatives as assigned.



B. TALENT ACQUISITION

• Partner with Department Heads and hiring stakeholders to identify workforce requirements and establish role qualifications.

• Develop and execute sourcing strategies to attract qualified candidates through job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct headhunting.

• Manage the end-to-end recruitment coordination process, including candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, follow-ups, and offer coordination.

• Maintain professional relationships and regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

• Coordinate recruitment assessments, background verification, and other pre-engagement requirements.

• Facilitate compensation discussions and coordinate proposed contractor rates and engagement terms with the appropriate approving authorities.

• Prepare and coordinate engagement offers and other recruitment-related documentation.

• Maintain accurate and updated Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), applicant databases, and recruitment calendars.

• Monitor recruitment progress and follow up with hiring stakeholders to ensure timely candidate evaluation and feedback.

• Prepare recruitment reports covering hiring progress, applicant pipeline, time-to-hire, time-to-fill, sourcing effectiveness, and recruitment funnel metrics.

• Identify recruitment bottlenecks and recommend process improvements to enhance hiring efficiency and candidate experience.



C. RECRUITMENT MARKETING

1. Social Media and Employer Branding

• Manage and maintain the company's recruitment social media platforms, including
, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

• Develop and implement recruitment marketing campaigns tailored to each platform and target audience.

• Create and publish engaging recruitment content, including job advertisements, hiring announcements, campaign materials, and employer branding posts.

• Manage online community engagement through audience interaction, comment moderation, and timely responses to messages and inquiries.

• Monitor social media performance, follower growth, engagement metrics, and campaign effectiveness.

• Ensure all recruitment content aligns with the company's employer branding, communication standards, and messaging.



2. Career Page and Recruitment Content Management

• Manage and maintain the company's career page, ensuring that job advertisements and recruitment information are accurate and updated.

• Publish recruitment blogs, career-related announcements, and other content that promotes the company as a remote contractor opportunity.

• Coordinate with Talent Acquisition to ensure timely publication and removal of job advertisements.

• Review recruitment content for accuracy, consistency, and alignment with approved job requirements.



3. VideoAsk and Candidate Engagement

• Upload, organize, and maintain VideoAsk recordings covering general recruitment questions and role-specific inquiries.

• Ensure recruitment videos and resources are accessible and updated to support candidate engagement and understanding of available opportunities.

• Coordinate with the recruitment team to identify additional content requirements based on frequently asked candidate questions.



4. Contractor Engagement and Internal Communications

• Prepare and publish contractor milestone announcements, including birthdays, work anniversaries, and promotions, through the People & Culture Slack channel.

• Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure the accuracy and timely publication of contractor announcements.

• Support internal engagement initiatives and other People & Culture communication activities as assigned.



5. Recruitment Events and Compensation Research

• Coordinate and facilitate virtual and on-site job fairs, recruitment campaigns, and other talent attraction events.

• Represent the company during recruitment events and engage with potential contractors.

• Conduct compensation research and market benchmarking for different roles to support competitive and fair contractor rate recommendations.

• Coordinate with Talent Acquisition and relevant stakeholders to align recruitment campaigns with current and projected hiring requirements.





Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resource Management, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.



Qualifications:

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in Human Resources, HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment Marketing, or a similar function.

• Experience handling HR documentation, recruitment coordination, and administrative processes is preferred.

• Exposure to social media management, employer branding, or recruitment campaigns is an advantage.

• Experience working in a remote or distributed team environment is preferred.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office applications.

• Familiarity with HRIS, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), and recruitment databases.

• Knowledge of recruitment platforms and social media management tools.

• Basic knowledge of recruitment marketing, content creation, and social media analytics.

• Strong documentation, reporting, and data management skills.



Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office applications.

• Familiarity with HRIS, Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), and recruitment databases.

• Knowledge of recruitment platforms and social media management tools.

• Basic knowledge of recruitment marketing, content creation, and social media analytics.

• Strong documentation, reporting, and data



Soft Skills:

• Communication Skills: Ability to communicate clearly and professionally through written and verbal channels.

• Interpersonal Skills: Ability to establish positive working relationships with candidates, contractors, supervisors, and internal stakeholders.

• Time Management: Ability to organize tasks, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet deadlines.

• Adaptability: Willingness to adjust to changing priorities, new processes, and different responsibilities across HR functions.

• Attention to Detail: Ability to maintain accuracy and consistency when handling documentation, recruitment records, reports, and marketing materials.

• Initiative and Proactiveness: Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks, anticipate needs, and work with minimal supervision.

• Problem-Solving: Ability to identify challenges, assess situations, and provide practical solutions to routine concerns.

• Teamwork and Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with colleagues and cross-functional teams toward shared objectives.

• Customer Service Orientation: Ability to demonstrate patience, empathy, and responsiveness when addressing candidate and contractor inquiries.

• Creativity and Resourcefulness: Ability to develop engaging ideas and practical approaches for recruitment campaigns and process improvements.

• Resilience and Stress Management: Ability to remain composed, productive, and professional when managing multiple assignments and tight deadlines.



Competencies and Attributes:

• Organization and Time Management: Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

• Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy and consistency in HR documentation, recruitment records, and published content.

• Communication Skills: Demonstrates clear, professional, and effective written and verbal communication.

• Coordination and Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders, candidates, and contractors.

• Adaptability: Able to transition between HR Operations, recruitment, and marketing responsibilities based on business priorities.

• Initiative and Problem-Solving: Identifies operational gaps and takes proactive steps to address routine challenges.

• Confidentiality and Professionalism: Handles sensitive contractor and recruitment information with discretion.

• Digital Proficiency: Comfortable using digital tools, recruitment platforms, HR systems, and social media channels.



Cultural Fit / Values Alignment:

• Integrity and Accountability: Demonstrates honesty, takes responsibility for assigned tasks and decisions, and consistently follows through on commitments.

• Ownership and Responsibility: Shows initiative, takes ownership of deliverables, and remains accountable for the quality and timeliness of work.

• Collaboration and Respect: Values teamwork, respects diverse perspectives, and maintains positive working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

• Commitment to Excellence: Demonstrates a willingness to learn, improve, and deliver quality work while maintaining high standards of accuracy and professionalism.

• Adaptability and Growth Mindset: Embraces change, welcomes constructive feedback, and demonstrates openness to learning new processes, systems, and responsibilities.

• Transparency and Open Communication: Communicates honestly, provides timely updates, raises concerns appropriately, and maintains transparency when handling work-related matters.

• Initiative and Continuous Improvement: Actively identifies opportunities to improve processes, contribute ideas, and support organizational goals.

• Professionalism and Trustworthiness: Demonstrates sound judgment, discretion, reliability, and respect for company policies and confidential information.

• Remote Work Discipline: Demonstrates self-management, dependability, responsiveness, and the ability to work independently while remaining connected and accountable to the team.

• Service-Oriented Mindset: Shows genuine concern for the experience of candidates, contractors, and internal stakeholders and strives to provide timely and helpful support.



Other Requirements:

• Able to work during US business hours (CST)

• Comfortable with remote work set-up

• Must have stable Internet and Power Connection





What's in it for You:

• Competitive Compensation: Earn $3.55 - $3.99 per hour, commensurate with your skills and experience.

• Work your way: Remote Work Set-Up enabling you to operate from the comfort and convenience of your own chosen workspace

• Success Incentives: Enjoy company bonuses and performance-driven rewards.

• Soar with Us: Opportunities for career growth and promotions await you.

• Annual Bonus: We value your dedication throughout the year, rewarding you with an annual performance bonus shared at the end of the year.

• Performance Raise: Your hard work doesn't go unnoticed. Be ready to seize opportunities for a salary increase based on your outstanding performance.

• Performance Incentives: We believe exceptional work deserves recognition. Performance incentives are awarded to individuals who demonstrate outstanding contributions, initiative, and results. It’s our way of celebrating excellence and motivating continued success.

• Discretionary Bonus: At Community Minerals, exceptional work doesn’t go unnoticed. Contractors who consistently go above and beyond may be rewarded with discretionary bonuses, a token of appreciation for outstanding contributions, impactful results, and dedication to excellence. Let your work speak, and the rewards will follow!





System Requirements:

To ensure optimal performance and functionality while using different web and application tools, please make sure that your system meets the following requirements:



Operating System:

Processor:

title: Sales, Production & Buying Coordinator
description:
Baby, Pet & Home Products - Part-time / Full-time



About the Role

We are looking for an organised and commercially minded Sales, Production & Buying Coordinator to join our team.

This is a hands-on role sitting at the centre of our sales, buying, production and inventory planning functions. You will help ensure we have the right stock, in the right quantities, at the right time, while coordinating customer requirements with our internal team, suppliers and production partners.

The role would suit someone who enjoys working with numbers and products, is highly organised, and can comfortably move between sales forecasts, purchase orders, production schedules, inventory and customer requirements.



Key Responsibilities

Sales & Demand Planning

Review sales performance, forecasts and customer requirements.

Assist with demand planning across wholesale, ecommerce and marketplace channels.

Monitor sales against forecast and identify potential stock shortages or excess inventory.

Coordinate major customer orders, promotions and seasonal requirements.

Work closely with the sales team to ensure stock availability supports upcoming opportunities.



Buying & Inventory Planning

Prepare and manage purchase orders.

Determine reorder quantities based on sales, forecasts, stock on hand and incoming inventory.

Monitor stock cover, sell-through and inventory levels.

Identify slow-moving and overstocked products.

Assist with seasonal and range-buying decisions.

Maintain accurate product costs, quantities and delivery information.



Production Coordination

Liaise with overseas suppliers and factories regarding production.

Maintain and update production schedules and critical-path timelines.

Track purchase orders from placement through production, shipment and delivery.

Follow up samples, approvals, packaging and production requirements.

Identify potential production or delivery delays early and communicate them internally.

Coordinate priorities between sales requirements, available inventory and factory capacity.

Reporting & Administration

Maintain accurate purchasing, production and inventory information within company systems.

Prepare regular stock, sales, purchasing and production reports.

Assist management with forecasting and forward purchasing decisions.

Work closely with sales, ecommerce, warehouse, finance and product teams.



About You

We are looking for someone who is commercial, analytical and exceptionally organised.

Ideally, you will have:

2+ years' experience in buying, merchandise planning, production coordination, supply chain or sales operations.

Experience working with consumer products, retail, wholesale or ecommerce.

Strong Excel skills, including spreadsheets, formulas, filtering and data analysis.

Experience with inventory, ERP or order-management systems.

Confidence working with sales forecasts, stock levels, purchase orders and production schedules.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Experience communicating with overseas factories or suppliers, particularly in China, would be highly regarded.

title: Full-time E-commerce VA – Shopify Product Research & Listing Quality Control
description:
About the role

We run several Shopify fashion and home stores in Europe, the UK and North America. Product research and listing creation run through our own in-house system. We are looking for a sharp, proactive VA who makes sure every product that goes live is a good product with a perfect listing. You become the quality gate between research and our live stores.



What you will do

- Competitor & product research: use tools like TrendTrack, Google Trends and Google Lens to find winning products, new trends and competitor stores. Add competitors and product ideas to our system.

- Pre-listing check: review every product before it is listed (right niche and season, good margin, no brand or trademark issues, complete data). Approve or reject it, and give a clear reason.

- Listing quality control: after a listing is created, check title, description, variants and colours, size chart, prices, photos and SEO fields against our SOPs. Fix small issues and report bigger ones.

- Follow the SOPs: work through our listing SOPs step by step, every time. Suggest improvements when you spot a pattern.

- Store support: daily checks on the stores (products, collections, Merchant Center warnings, anything that looks off).

- Trend watching: keep an eye on seasonal and new trends, and send a short weekly overview of what is rising.

- General VA tasks: check things for me, do small research tasks and look up information when needed.

- Make sure you build a good list of competitors and a good list of collections and products.



Pinterest/Google ads support (working with our ads agency)



- Find video ads that perform well on Meta and Pinterest. Use the Meta Ad Library, the Pinterest Trends and Ads Library, TikTok

Creative Center and similar tools.

- Collect the best product videos, list the product in our Shopify store, and add it to the agency's launch sheet (up to 20 products, always with a video).

- Keep the launch sheet up to date every week, so the agency always has fresh products and videos to test.

- When the agency asks for content, arrange short product videos (5–15 seconds, phone quality is fine, ideally worn by a person) and upload them to the launch sheet.

- Read the agency's weekly update (spend, revenue, ROAS, best products) and turn it into actions: which products need more videos, which ones to remove (for example summer items in winter).



Requirements

- Hands-on Shopify experience (products, variants, collections, admin). This is a must.

- Very comfortable with online tools. You learn new software fast.

- Experience with product research (TrendTrack, Google Trends, Google Lens or similar tools) is a big plus.

- A strong eye for detail: you notice a wrong colour name, a missing size or a bad photo.

- Good written English.

- Reliable internet and your own laptop or PC.

- Able to work independently and report clearly: what you did, what you found, what needs a decision.

- Experience with CRM 



Salary & bonus

- $385 per month (approx. PHP 22,000), full-time, 40 hours per week.

- Monthly performance bonus of $55 (approx. PHP 3,200) when your listings pass quality control, the SOPs are followed, and the products you approved perform well (sales, few issues).



Who we are looking for

A real go-getter: productive, curious and proactive. You don't wait for instructions when you see something that can be better. You care about quality, and you like finding the next winning product.



Nice to have

- Experience with dropshipping or fashion e-commerce

- Google Merchant Center experience

- Experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) for research or copywriting



Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with some overlap with European time (CET).



How to apply

Send a short message with:

1. Your Shopify experience: which stores, and what you did there

2. Which product research tools you have used

3. 3 products you think will trend in the next 3 months, and why (2-3 sentences)

4. Start your message with the word "QUALITY", so we know you read the full post



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test task: research 5 products and check 3 listings.

title: Video Ad Editor (AI - First)
description:
⚠️ HOW TO APPLY: APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A LOOM VIDEO LINK ARE NOT READ. 

THE LOOM MUST BE RECORDED FOR THIS APPLICATION. 

A LOOM YOU MADE FOR OTHER JOBS, OR OLDER THAN 7 DAYS, IS MARKED UNQUALIFIED. 

START YOUR MESSAGE WITH THE WORDS "AI-FIRST EDITOR" SO WE KNOW YOU READ THE WHOLE POST.



WHO WE ARE

We are a fast-growing, seven-figure health and wellness ecommerce brand. We help people in pain feel human again, and we grow through Meta ads in the US. You'll get clear, detailed briefs and scripts every day, so you can focus on what you do best: turning them into ads people stop scrolling for.



Once you've proven your ambition, you'll get extensive on-the-job training. Learn how ads that sell are made, and you can grow from a video editor into the person who plans our ads, earning a multi-five-figure USD salary.



You'd be a full-time creative hire, working directly with the founder. You'll have clear weekly targets, a weekly meeting where we review how last week's ads performed and what to make next, and a weekly presentation from you: what you learned, where you learned it, and how you'll apply it to your edits.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

You won't spend your days dragging clips on a timeline. We edit with AI: AI drives editing software, and we use AI tools for voice and music. B-roll depends on the ad: AI-generated for animated or claymation ads etc., and for other ads our own footage library, stock footage or clips you source online. Your job is to guide the AI, pick the right footage for each scene, and make great ads fast. Quality + Speed. When your ads perform well, you earn a bonus.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn raw footage and AI b-roll into scroll-stopping ads, fast

- Direct AI tools to cut, caption, resize and create variations

- Make different versions of the first 3 seconds of an ad every week, and learn which ones people stop for



REQUIREMENTS

- AI-first editor: you already use AI to automate your editing (cutting, captions, b-roll, voiceover, resizes), and your job is to direct it and check the output, not to drag clips by hand

- Resourceful: when you hit a problem, you find the tool, the tutorial or the workaround yourself before asking

- You build systems: if you do something twice, you look for a way to automate it

- You've edited ads (not just YouTube or wedding videos) and can explain why an ad's first 3 seconds grab attention

- Hungry: you're learning something new every week, and you never settle once you're comfortable

- Reliable: you hit deadlines and communicate without being chased

- Strong written English: you can follow a detailed brief exactly



DEAL-BREAKERS

- You've never used AI in your editing

- You need step-by-step instructions to figure out new tools

- You miss deadlines without telling anyone

- You want part-time work or are juggling other clients. This is a full-time role.

- You edit everything by hand and aren't interested in automating it

- You stop learning once the job feels comfortable



PAY

$1,800+/month base, set by your paid test. Plus a cash bonus for every ad you edit that becomes one of our best performers: up to $250 per ad, no limit on how many. Raise review at 90 days. No ceiling: if your ads earn it, you earn it.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Loom application (below)

2. 20-minute call

3. Paid test project: one short ad from our brief, delivered within 48 hours

4. Offer + 30-day trial



HOW TO APPLY (required — applications without a Loom are not reviewed)

Record a Loom, max 5 minutes:

1. Introduce yourself in 30 seconds

2. Show 2–3 ads you're proud of, and their results if you have them

3. Show your screen and walk us through the hardest editing problem you've solved using AI or a workaround you built. What was the problem, and how exactly did you solve it? Any tools are fine.



PS: A year from now, you'll either still be taking small gigs, or you'll be earning more than you thought possible while learning how winning ads are made and the fundamentals of marketing. 

The difference is what you do in the next 5 minutes. Record the Loom today.

title: Customer Support & Supplier Onboarding Supervisor
description:
Customer Support & Supplier Onboarding Supervisor 



Company: Keylr (Key Riders Ltd), London Location: Philippines – 100% remote / work from home Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time (40 hrs/week) Hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time (17:00–02:00 Manila during UK winter / 16:00–01:00 during UK summer time) Reports to: Founder & CEO (UK)



About Keylr



Keylr is a fast-growing London B2B marketplace connecting property managers, estate agents and short-term rental operators with verified local trade suppliers – plumbers, electricians, locksmiths, cleaners, handymen and more. We run the jobs end to end: a client raises a maintenance request, we match it to a vetted supplier, and we make sure it gets done.

This is our first operations hire in the Philippines. You will start as a hands-on individual contributor running support, onboarding and dispatch day to day, and as volumes grow you will hire and supervise junior agents underneath you.



The Role



You are the voice of Keylr for both sides of the marketplace. You answer the phone when a property manager has an urgent leak, you chase a plumber for a missing insurance certificate, and you make sure every open job has a supplier on it. You also write down how we do things, so that the next person you hire can do it the same way.



Key Responsibilities



1. Inbound support – clients and suppliers



Handle inbound calls,
s and tickets from property managers and trade suppliers during UK business hours

Resolve queries on job status, quotes, invoices, payments, platform access and account set-up

Own escalations: supplier no-shows, emergency repairs, SLA breaches and complaints – keep the client informed until it is closed

Log every interaction accurately in the helpdesk/CRM



2. Supplier onboarding & compliance checking



Run the supplier onboarding pipeline: outbound calls to new applicants, guiding them through profile set-up on the Keylr platform

Check and verify documents: Public Liability Insurance (cover level and expiry), trade certifications (e.g. Gas Safe, NICEIC), company/VAT details and bank details

Chase missing or expired documents by phone and
 until the file is complete

Keep the supplier compliance records up to date and flag expiring documents before they lapse



3. Dispatch & job allocation



Monitor the job queue and make sure no job sits unallocated

Call panel suppliers to offer jobs and secure acceptance at the agreed rate card

Follow up on accepted jobs: attendance, status updates, completion photos and sign-off

Re-allocate quickly when a supplier drops out



4. SOPs & process documentation



Write and maintain SOPs for support, onboarding, compliance checks and dispatch

Build call scripts,
 templates, macros and canned responses

Create a simple help-centre / FAQ for clients and suppliers

Suggest process improvements based on what you see in the queue



5. Reporting & future team leadership



Send a weekly report to the CEO: tickets handled, response times, suppliers onboarded, documents outstanding, jobs allocated/unallocated, escalations

As volumes grow, help recruit, train and supervise junior support and dispatch agents



Requirements



Must have

3+ years in customer service, contact centre, dispatch or operations, with at least 1 year as a team lead, supervisor or senior agent

Experience supporting UK or other Western clients

Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent

Confident making outbound calls – comfortable chasing busy tradespeople firmly but politely

Very strong attention to detail when checking documents

Experience writing SOPs, scripts or training material

Comfortable with helpdesk/CRM tools (e.g. Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot) and cloud phone systems (e.g. Aircall, RingCentral)

Able to work the full UK-hours shift consistently, Monday to Friday



Nice to have



Background in property management, facilities, field service, home services or a marketplace (e.g. Grab, foodpanda, Lalamove merchant/rider ops)

Experience with property maintenance software (Fixflo, Reapit, Arthur or similar)

Experience vetting supplier or contractor documents (insurance, certifications)

Experience hiring or training agents



Equipment & Home Office Requirements



As an independent contractor you provide your own equipment and workspace:



Laptop or desktop: Intel i5 / Ryzen 5 or better, 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB preferred), Windows 10/11 or macOS

USB noise-cancelling headset with microphone (e.g. Jabra, Logitech, Poly) – mandatory

Fibre internet, minimum 50 Mbps

UPS or power backup able to run your setup through a brownout

Quiet, dedicated workspace free from background noise

Webcam for video meetings



What We Offer



Monthly base fee: PHP 45,000



Onboarding bonus: PHP 100 for every supplier taken to fully compliant status (all required documents verified and approved by Keylr), paid monthly, uncapped



Bonus is paid only on suppliers that pass Keylr's compliance audit; any approved on invalid or incorrect documents are deducted from the following month

Monday–Friday fixed schedule, weekends off

100% remote

Direct line to the founder and a real path to lead the Philippines operations team as we grow



How to Apply



Send all three of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



CV showing your support, dispatch or operations experience, any team-lead experience, and any UK client work



Voice recording (1–2 minutes) via Vocaroo, Loom, Google Drive or an MP3 link, answering: "Introduce yourself, describe your experience in customer support or operations, and explain why you would be confident calling a UK plumber to chase a missing insurance certificate."



Two professional references, at least one a former direct supervisor (name, title, company,
)



Hiring Process



Application screening: CV, voice recording and references

First interview (30 min, video): experience, English and phone confidence, including a short role-play call

Practical task (45 min): (a) a phone script and
 follow-up to chase a supplier for missing Public Liability Insurance; (b) a step-by-step workflow for a supplier no-show on an urgent leak

Final interview with the CEO

Reference checks and contract

title: Construction Estimator / Project Manager
description:
Please, all the hiring process will be led through this platform. Do not send any e-mails.



About the Role



At Apex Veteran Construction, we deliver high-integrity construction projects across federal, state,

municipal, commercial, and residential sectors. We are seeking a detail-driven Construction

Estimator / Project Manager to lead our preconstruction and bidding engine—and seamlessly

transition awarded projects into successful field execution.

In this dual-impact role, you will own the full opportunity lifecycle: sourcing and qualifying public and

private bids, executing calibrated digital takeoffs, building auditable cost models, ensuring airtight

solicitation compliance, and leading post-award handoffs and financial tracking through project

closeout.



Required Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)



Candidates must meet all of the following core qualifications to be considered:



5 Years of Public-Sector Estimating & Project Management Experience: Proven

experience estimating and/or managing federal, state, and municipal construction projects,

alongside residential and commercial experience as relevant to workload.



Demonstrable Track Record of Awarded Bids: Verified history of project sizes, agencies,

personal role in bid preparation, measurable win rates, and post-award financial outcomes.



Public Procurement & Compliance Expertise: Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS and

state/local procurement regulations, including Davis-Bacon / prevailing wage compliance,

public works labor standards, and bid/performance/payment bonding requirements.



Technical Software Proficiency: Hands-on proficiency with STACK, Contractor Foreman,

Microsoft Excel, and Bluebeam.



Communication, Precision & Ethics: Strong communication, document control discipline,

strict deadline ownership under bid calendars, and unwavering commitment to procurement

integrity and confidentiality.





Why Join Apex Veteran Construction?



End-to-End Ownership: See the direct impact of your estimates—guide the estimate-tooperations kickoff, subcontractor buyout, and job-cost tracking from award through completion.

Modern Preconstruction Tech Stack: Work with industry-standard digital platforms including

STACK, Contractor Foreman, Bluebeam, and structured Excel cost models.

Clear Governance & Executive Backing: Structured Go/No-Go reviews, defined bid calendars,

and direct leadership approval on final pricing, bonding, and contract terms so you never bid

unsupported.



High-Integrity Culture: We compete with strict procurement ethics, verified veteran/smallbusiness representations, and disciplined quality control focused on sustainable win rates.



Key Responsibilities



Opportunity Sourcing & Go/No-Go Qualification

Monitor federal, state, municipal, utility, and private procurement portals (including 
,

state/local bid boards, and plan rooms) on a structured weekly rhythm to identify qualified

opportunities.

Log solicitations, track mandatory site visits, RFI deadlines, and addenda, and prepare Go/No-Go

evaluations covering technical fit, workload, margin potential, schedule, and bonding/insurance

capacity.



Digital Takeoffs, Cost Modeling & Subcontractor Buyout



Interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, and addenda; conduct calibrated

digital quantity takeoffs by CSI division/trade using STACK and Bluebeam.

Build detailed, traceable cost models in Excel and Contractor Foreman covering labor, materials,

equipment, general conditions, prevailing wages, taxes, logistics, waste, and contingencies.

Solicit and level comparable subcontractor and supplier quotes, verify trade licensing and

insurance, and document all estimating assumptions, inclusions, exclusions, and alternates.



Public-Sector Compliance & Bid Governance



Manage solicitation-specific compliance matrices covering FAR/DFARS, state/local procurement

rules, Davis-Bacon/prevailing wage determinations, certified payroll, domestic preferences, and

participation goals (SDVOSB/VOSB, DBE/MWBE, HUD Section 3, E-Verify) where applicable.

Coordinate bid bonds, payment/performance bond confirmations, insurance certificates, and presubmission responsiveness checklists to ensure 100% compliant, on-time bid submissions.

Track bid tabulations, post-bid debriefs, and monthly win/loss analytics to continuously refine

company cost libraries.



Post-Award Handoff & Project Coordination



Lead formal estimate-to-operations handoff kickoffs within five business days of award—

transferring quantity backups, bid assumptions, quotes, compliance matrices, and schedule risks.

Build baseline contract budgets and Schedules of Values (SOV), support subcontractor buyout,

and maintain submittal, RFI, and change-order logs.



Monitor job-cost variances, enforce written authorization before out-of-scope work proceeds, and

support closeout deliverables (punch lists, as-builts, O&M manuals, warranties, and lien waivers).

description:

About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise clients. They need to know their data is safe and that our products meet European rules, so we are hiring someone whose full focus is compliance.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You make sure every product we ship is compliant and properly documented. You report to our Head of Operations and work closely with our Head of Technology and Head of Product.



- Compliance documentation: keep it current for every product and client project, including data flows, processing records, security measures and risk assessments

- Client agreements: prepare data processing agreements and answer client security questionnaires

- Regulation checks: check products against GDPR and the EU AI Act, and flag gaps early to the product owner

- Internal policies: maintain our policies on data retention, access management and i
 response, and make sure teams follow them

- AI model register: track which AI models and hosting locations each product uses, so we can answer client questions fast

- Audits: support audits and certification work, such as ISO 27001



We are an AI company, and we want someone who helps our clients use AI safely and with confidence. That doesn't mean saying yes to everything. Sometimes good advice is "yes, and here's how." Sometimes it's "not like this." We value both, and we want you to speak up when something is at risk.





What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 2+ years of experience in compliance, data privacy, IT audit or information security

title: Cybersecurity Lead (Application and Infrastructure Security), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained.



ABOUT MSTR



MSTR is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise companies.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Security work is currently shared by our infra and DevOps teams, alongside their main jobs. We want one person to own it end to end, set the standard, and be able to block a release.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. You start as our security lead and build this into a small department over time.



LOCATION AND WORKING SET-UP

- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 3:00 p.m - 12:00 a.m Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Dependency and supply-chain hygiene across all repos: Dependabot or Renovate, npm/pip/NuGet audits, SBOMs, a fixed patch cadence, and triaging what is actually exploitable

- Pentesting our own products and the custom builds for clients, before release and on a recurring schedule

- Security checks in CI: SAST, secrets scanning, container and IaC scanning, and DAST against staging

- Cloud and platform posture on Azure and Supabase: identity and access, row-level security (RLS), network exposure, key management

- AI-specific risks: prompt injection, MCP and tool permissions, data leaking through LLM calls, and which model providers may see client data

- Own i
 response and a vulnerability disclosure process

- Support enterprise security questionnaires and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 readiness)

- Build security into a small department over time and set the rules the developers follow



HOW WE SPLIT THE WORK

- DevOps runs the platform. Security sets policy, finds issues, checks the fixes, and has veto on releases.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-have:

- At least 4 years in application security or pentesting, with real findings you can walk us through

- Strong grip on the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM Top 10

- Hands-on with Burp Suite or similar

- Can read and fix code in our stacks: TypeScript/React/Next, Python, .NET, Postgres

- Azure security experience

- Supabase experience

- You write clear findings that a developer can act on and a client can read

- You take ownership without being chased. This is a lead role, not an assistant role.

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal



Nice-to-have:

- OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or an Azure security certification

- A bug bounty track record

- Has gone through ISO 27001 or SOC 2 with a company

- Has used Claude Code for security review



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code or similar tools for code review or security work, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the security function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real authority: you have veto on releases

- Interesting problems: application, infrastructure and AI security in one role

- A clear growth path: build and lead a small security department

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



OUR STACK

- Cloud and platform: Azure, Supabase

- Languages and frameworks: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, .NET

- Database: Postgres



HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into application security.

2. A finding you are proud of: Walk us through a real vulnerability you found. How did you find it, what was the impact, and how did you get it fixed? Leave out anything confidential.

3. Stopping a release: Tell us about a time you had to say "this can't go live yet". How did you explain it, and how did you get the team on your side?
