title: Commercial Roofing Estimator
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Experience: Proven experience in Australian roofing estimating, preferably across commercial roofing, roof plumbing, and re-roofing projects



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are seeking an experienced Commercial Roofing Estimator to join an established Australian roofing and roof plumbing business servicing residential and commercial properties across South Australia.



This role will be responsible for preparing accurate and commercially competitive estimates, quotations, and tender submissions for a range of roofing projects. The successful candidate will review project documentation, interpret roofing plans and specifications, complete material take-offs, obtain supplier and subcontractor pricing, and prepare detailed cost estimates.



The business provides a range of roofing services, including metal and tiled roof repairs, complete re-roofing, COLORBOND® roof installations, gutters and downpipes, roof plumbing, flashing, stormwater drainage, roof inspections, and emergency roofing works.



The ideal candidate will have hands-on Australian roofing estimating experience, a strong understanding of roofing materials and installation requirements, and the ability to accurately price projects from drawings, specifications, site information, and scopes of work.



This is a detail-oriented role requiring strong commercial awareness, excellent numerical skills, and the ability to manage multiple quotations and estimating requests while working closely with an Australian-based team.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Roofing Estimating & Tender Preparation – Primary Focus

- Review architectural drawings, roofing plans, specifications, scopes of work, and tender documentation.

- Prepare detailed estimates, quotations, and tender submissions for residential and commercial roofing projects.

- Complete material take-offs for roofing sheets, tiles, flashings, gutters, downpipes, insulation, and associated accessories.

- Calculate roof areas, lengths, quantities, material requirements, and installation costs.

- Estimate costs for labour, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and other project-related expenses.

- Review project specifications to identify the appropriate roofing systems, materials, and installation requirements.

- Obtain and compare supplier and subcontractor quotations.

- Review quotations to ensure all inclusions, exclusions, quantities, and scope requirements are accurately captured.

- Identify missing information, discrepancies, potential scope gaps, and cost risks.

- Prepare detailed estimating worksheets, cost breakdowns, and supporting tender documentation.

- Review estimates for accuracy, completeness, and commercial competitiveness before submission.

- Update estimates when drawings, specifications, or project requirements change.

- Manage multiple estimating requests while meeting quotation and tender deadlines.

2. Roofing Systems & Technical Estimating

- Estimate a range of roofing systems and associated works, including:

- COLORBOND® and metal roofing

- Tiled roofing

- Metal roof replacements and upgrades

- Tile-to-metal roof conversions

- Complete re-roofing projects

- Roof leak repairs and maintenance

- Roof flashing and roof plumbing

- Gutter and downpipe installations and replacements

- Stormwater drainage and associated roof drainage works

- Roof insulation and related roofing components, where applicable

- Review roofing plans and specifications to determine the appropriate materials and quantities.

- Understand roof profiles, pitches, dimensions, overlaps, flashing requirements, and installation considerations.

- Identify the materials and labour required for roof removal, replacement, and installation.

- Account for access requirements, roof heights, site conditions, and project complexity when preparing estimates.

- Identify potential technical issues or unclear specifications and raise queries for clarification.

- Understand the differences between roofing repair, maintenance, replacement, and new installation scopes.

3. Roof Plumbing, Gutters & Drainage Estimating

- Prepare estimates for roof plumbing works, including flashings, gutters, downpipes, and associated drainage components.

- Calculate quantities and lengths for guttering, downpipes, flashings, and related materials.

- Review drawings and specifications to identify stormwater drainage requirements.

- Estimate material and labour costs for gutter and downpipe repairs, replacements, and installations.

- Identify drainage requirements and potential issues affecting the scope of work.

- Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors to obtain pricing for specialised roof plumbing and drainage components.

- Ensure all associated works are captured in the estimate.

4. Supplier & Cost Management

- Request and follow up on supplier quotations for roofing materials, products, and accessories.

- Maintain current supplier pricing and product information.

- Compare material pricing and supplier quotations to ensure estimates remain commercially competitive.

- Review supplier quotations for accuracy, availability, specifications, and lead times.

- Identify changes in material costs that may affect project pricing.

- Maintain historical pricing, supplier information, and estimating records.

- Develop and maintain organised pricing information to support future quotations and tenders.

5. Drawing Interpretation & Technical Review

- Read and interpret architectural, structural, roofing, and construction drawings.

- Identify roofing dimensions, roof areas, pitches, profiles, and material specifications.

- Review scopes of work and technical documentation to understand project requirements.

- Cross-check quantities against drawings, specifications, and available schedules.

- Identify discrepancies, missing details, and conflicting information.

- Raise technical queries where clarification is required before finalising estimates.

- Understand relevant Australian roofing practices, material requirements, and installation considerations.

- Consider site-specific conditions and access requirements that may influence project costs.

6. Client & Tender Management

- Interact directly with clients to understand project requirements, scopes of work, specifications, and expectations.

- Respond to client enquiries relating to estimates, quotations, pricing, and tender submissions.

- Clarify project details, inclusions, exclusions, and technical requirements with clients.

- Drive tender opportunities from initial enquiry and documentation review through to pricing, submission, and follow-up.

- Coordinate tender timelines and ensure submissions are accurate, complete, and delivered within deadlines.

- Follow up on submitted tenders and quotations to obtain feedback and identify potential opportunities.

- Build and maintain professional relationships with clients and key stakeholders.

- Identify potential scope changes, variations, and additional works that may affect project pricing.

7. Subcontractor Coordination & Pricing

- Liaise directly with subcontractors to obtain quotations, confirm pricing, and clarify project scopes.

- Request, review, and compare subcontractor quotations for roofing and associated works.

- Ensure subcontractor pricing accurately reflects project requirements, quantities, inclusions, and exclusions.

- Follow up on outstanding quotations and pricing information to meet tender deadlines.

- Clarify labour, material, installation, access, and other project-specific requirements with subcontractors.

- Identify discrepancies or gaps in subcontractor quotations and seek clarification where necessary.

- Maintain professional working relationships with subcontractors and relevant trade partners.

- Coordinate subcontractor pricing and information throughout the tender preparation process.

8. Team Collaboration & Communication

- Work closely with the Australian management team, roof plumbers, project coordinators, and other relevant stakeholders.

- Communicate clearly regarding project scope, pricing, technical requirements, and outstanding information.

- Follow up on missing drawings, specifications, and supplier quotations required to complete estimates.

- Proactively identify potential estimating issues before they affect project costs or submission deadlines.

- Participate in online meetings, project discussions, and estimate reviews during Australian business hours.

- Maintain organised records of estimates, quotations, revisions, and supporting documentation.

- Support improvements in estimating accuracy, consistency, and workflow efficiency.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience in Australian roofing estimating.

- Experience preparing estimates, quotations, and tender submissions for roofing projects.

- Strong understanding of Australian roofing materials, systems, and installation practices.

- Experience estimating metal roofing, tiled roofing, and/or re-roofing projects.

- Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, roofing, and construction drawings.

- Demonstrated experience preparing material take-offs and calculating roofing quantities.

- Understanding of roof profiles, pitches, dimensions, flashings, gutters, downpipes, and associated components.

- Familiarity with roof plumbing and stormwater drainage requirements.

- Experience obtaining and comparing Australian supplier and subcontractor pricing.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills and familiarity with digital estimating tools.

- Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.

- Ability to identify discrepancies, scope gaps, and potential cost risks.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet deadlines.

- Organised, proactive, and capable of working independently.

- Comfortable working remotely with an Australian-based team.

HIGHLY DESIRABLE

- Experience estimating commercial roofing projects.

- Experience with large-scale re-roofing and metal roofing installations.

- Experience with COLORBOND® roofing products and systems.

- Background in roof plumbing, guttering, downpipes, and stormwater drainage.

- Experience estimating both residential and commercial roofing works.

- Familiarity with South Australian building requirements, roofing regulations, and relevant Australian standards.

- Experience with digital take-off, estimating, and construction management software.

- Experience coordinating with roofing contractors, suppliers, subcontractors, and project managers.

- Relevant qualification or trade background in roofing, roof plumbing, construction, quantity surveying, or a related discipline.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this role means consistently delivering accurate, competitive, and timely roofing estimates and quotations, while ensuring all project requirements, materials, labour, and associated works are properly accounted for.



The successful candidate will become a reliable estimating resource who can independently review roofing documentation, complete detailed material take-offs, obtain accurate supplier pricing, and prepare commercially sound quotations.



Success means:

- Producing accurate estimates for Australian roofing projects.

- Correctly identifying roofing materials, quantities, and installation requirements.

- Understanding the cost implications of different roofing systems and project scopes.

- Accurately estimating roof plumbing, gutters, downpipes, and associated drainage works.

- Identifying discrepancies and missing information before they affect project costs.

- Maintaining reliable supplier pricing and estimating records.

- Managing multiple quotations while meeting deadlines.

- Communicating proactively with the Australian team.

THE OPPORTUNITY

- Full-time remote position based in the Philippines.

- Work Australian business hours.

- Join an established Australian roofing and roof plumbing business.

- Support a diverse range of residential and commercial roofing projects.

- Work across roof repairs, re-roofing, metal roofing, gutters, downpipes, and roof plumbing.

- Collaborate with an experienced Australian team.

- Long-term opportunity for an experienced roofing estimator.

Can you own a full portfolio of projects, set the processes that keep a growing team on track, and deliver results on time and on budget when the stakes are high?



We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead strategic initiatives from start to finish, guide the people doing the work, and build the systems we’ll scale on. If you think strategically, care about the details, and want your leadership to support a brand that changes how people care for themselves, we’d love to hear from you.



ABOUT US

We’re a fast-growing holistic beauty company that helps people look and feel their best through natural, whole-body practices. Our remote team works with one of the fastest-growing holistic beauty creators in the world, followed by more than 3,000,000 people. We’ll share more details during the interview.



The people who do best here care about the mission as much as the work. If you already practice or follow holistic wellness, you’ll feel at home with us.

- Outstanding achievements, such as Latin Honors (Summa Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Cum Laude), excellence awards (e.g., “Employee of the Year”), or fast career growth into leadership roles

- At least 5 years of project management experience, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead role

- Experience managing several projects at once with cross-functional or remote teams

- Proven ownership of project budgets, timelines, and resource planning

- A track record of creating or improving project management processes, workflows, and SOPs

- Strong command of project management tools (e.g., Asana, ClickUp, 
, Notion, Jira)

- Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, content production, or consumer brands (a strong plus)

PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification (preferred, not required)

- Executive-level written and spoken communication, with the confidence to present to and influence senior stakeholders

- Sound judgment and decisiveness in high-pressure situations

- Strong leadership: able to mentor, delegate, and hold team members accountable



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead the planning and execution of high-priority projects and company initiatives from start to finish

- Work with leadership to define project scope, goals, deliverables, and success metrics

- Manage a portfolio of projects at once, balancing priorities, resources, and budgets

- Lead, mentor, and coordinate internal team members and external partners

- Build and refine project management frameworks, workflows, and documentation standards as the company grows

- Spot risks early, put mitigation plans in place, and escalate critical issues with clear recommendations

- Give leadership regular reports on progress, performance, and key decisions

- Manage change requests, scope changes, and stakeholder expectations

- Track project KPIs and use data to improve delivery and efficiency

- Resolve complex problems and conflicts with sound judgment and professionalism



REQUIREMENTS FOR REMOTE WORK

- A reliable computer or laptop

- A high-speed internet connection, plus a backup

- A quiet, distraction-free workspace



WORKING SCHEDULE

- Full-time



BENEFITS

- Competitive salary

- Training and development opportunities

- A key role in shaping how a fast-growing holistic beauty company runs

- A clear path to senior leadership and operations roles



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Since this is a long-term position, there will be an in-depth qualification process. If you believe you have what it takes, here's what to do next:



Please click the link below, review the questions carefully, and share the required information.






If you believe you meet our qualifications and requirements, we encourage you to apply now and become a valuable part of our rapidly expanding company.

title: Rebar Estimator – Residential & Commercial Construction
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Working Hours: Australian Business Hours

Experience: Minimum 2 years of Australian reinforcing steel estimating experience



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are seeking an experienced Rebar Estimator to support an established Australian steel reinforcing business servicing residential and commercial construction projects.



This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience interpreting Australian construction and structural drawings, calculating reinforcing steel quantities, and preparing accurate material take-offs for concrete reinforcement projects.



The primary focus will be estimating reinforcing steel requirements for residential and commercial developments, including reinforcing bar, reinforcing mesh, and associated accessories. You will work with construction drawings and project specifications to determine reinforcement quantities, identify requirements, and provide accurate estimating information to support quotations, scheduling, and project delivery.



The successful candidate will have a solid understanding of Australian reinforcing steel practices, be comfortable working with structural and engineering drawings, and understand how reinforcement requirements translate into material quantities and project costs.



This is a practical, detail-oriented role for someone who can work independently, manage multiple projects, and deliver accurate estimates while collaborating with an Australian team.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Rebar Estimating & Material Take-Offs – Primary Focus

- Review architectural, structural, and engineering drawings to identify reinforcing steel requirements.

- Prepare detailed material take-offs for residential and commercial construction projects.

- Calculate reinforcing bar quantities, lengths, sizes, and weights based on drawings and specifications.

- Estimate reinforcing mesh quantities and associated requirements.

- Identify the reinforcing steel products, grades, sizes, and accessories required for each project.

- Calculate quantities for reinforcement used in concrete slabs, footings, beams, columns, walls, and other reinforced concrete elements, where applicable.

- Review drawings and specifications to identify reinforcement details and project-specific requirements.

- Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential issues that could affect quantities or estimates.

- Prepare accurate estimating worksheets, quantity summaries, and supporting documentation.

- Assist with preparing quotations and pricing information based on calculated quantities and applicable material costs.

- Review estimates for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.

- Assist with revisions to estimates when drawings, specifications, or project requirements change.

- Manage multiple estimating requests while meeting deadlines and maintaining accuracy.

2. Drawing Interpretation & Technical Support

- Read and interpret Australian structural and engineering drawings relevant to reinforcing steel.

- Understand reinforcement symbols, bar sizes, spacing, cover requirements, laps, and other relevant detailing information.

- Identify reinforcement requirements across different elements of residential and commercial concrete structures.

- Review reinforcement schedules and bar details where provided.

title: Full-Time Senior Bookkeeper | AU
description:
PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



1. You do not have at least 5 years of hands-on Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience. General accounting experience outside Australia does not count towards this requirement.



2. You have never independently managed Australian payroll, including employee setup, weekly payroll processing, PAYG withholding and superannuation.



3. You are not confident with Australian GST, BAS and other relevant taxation requirements.



4. You do not have strong, hands-on experience using Xero, including bank reconciliations, accounts payable and accounts receivable.



5. You have no practical experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.



6. You require constant supervision, regular reminders or step-by-step instructions to manage your daily responsibilities.



7. You are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment where accuracy, urgency and accountability are essential.



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare weekly payroll including setting up new staff in Xero.

- Process, check and allocate supplier invoices and customer payments accurately.

- Record foreign currency invoices.

- Monitor overdue invoices and proactively follow up outstanding payments.

- Identify and investigate duplicate payments, incorrect invoices, overpayments, underpayments and other discrepancies.

- Cross-check information rather than assuming transactions or records are correct.

- Review courier/freight invoices and compare actual charges against quoted freight and freight charged to customers.

- Identify unexpected charges, discrepancies and potential underquoting.

- Liaise with our accountant and respond to requests promptly.

- Maintain clear notes and accurate financial records.

- Follow outstanding matters through until they are fully resolved, not simply identified.

- Proactively flag anything unusual to management.



What We're Looking For

You must be someone who is:

- Extremely detail-oriented. Small discrepancies matter in this role.

- Able to work accurately in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment.

- Proactive and able to identify what needs attention without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable monitoring
s, payments and financial activity throughout the day.

- Able to prioritise urgent financial matters while still completing routine responsibilities.

- Confident in investigating discrepancies using the information and systems available to you.

- Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.

- Strong at following up. If something remains unresolved, we expect you to keep it on your radar.

- Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable and consistently available during agreed working hours.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.



Mandatory Requirements

* Proven professional bookkeeping experience.

* You must have a minimum of 5 years of professional Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience.

* Experience with Xero.

* Strong reconciliation, accounts payable and accounts receivable experience.

* Must have hands-on experience with Australian payroll, including setting up new employees and preparing/processing weekly payroll.

* Must have a strong working knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements, including GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation.

* Must have hands-on experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Experience investigating financial discrepancies.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional work-from-home setup.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work full-time during Melbourne business hours.

* Must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.

* To confirm that you have read the full job description and understand the requirements of the role, please include the word “OFFROAD” in the subject line of your application.



Highly Advantageous

*Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

*Australian e-commerce or retail businesses

*Shopify

*Inventory management/accounting systems

*Freight or logistics reconciliation

*High-volume transaction environments

*Working directly with external Australian accountants



This position requires constant attention and ownership.



This Role May Not Be For You If...



If you prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned, checking
s only occasionally, leaving discrepancies for someone else to investigate, or needing regular reminders to follow up outstanding matters, this role will likely not be the right fit.

We need someone who sees something that doesn't look right and thinks:

“I need to check this.” and not: “Someone will tell me if there's a problem.”



Working Hours

Shift Hours – Full-Time Monday to Friday

Melbourne Time: (AEST/AEDT): 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Philippine Time: (PHT): 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM (6:00 AM - 3:00 PM during AEDT)

Includes a 1-hour lunch break (unpaid)

Applicants must be able to consistently work Melbourne business hours.



TO APPLY

To be considered for this position:

You MUST submit an updated resume/CV.

You must have relevant professional bookkeeping experience.

You must have strong written and spoken English communication skills.

You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

You must be available during the stated Melbourne working hours.

You must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

title: On-Call Personal & Property Assistant – UK Property Business (ad hoc, 2–15 hrs/week, works alongside another job)
description:
On-Call Personal & Property Assistant for a UK property business: ad hoc, usually 2–15 hours a week



About us

We're a small, family-run UK property business that lets houses, rooms and studios. The owner wants a dependable assistant for the property side and for some personal admin, which is why this is a combined personal and property assistant role. He has other businesses too, but they won't be your focus. He has worked with remote assistants for several years.



How we work: led by AI, powered by a person

AI agents already run much of our day-to-day work. They triage the inboxes, draft and send
s and WhatsApp messages (sometimes on your behalf, sometimes on their own account), track tasks and follow set routines for lettings and property management. You'll work mainly with two of these agents. They'll brief you, tell you what needs doing and support you as you go.



What they can't replace is a sensible, reliable person. You will be:



• The eyes and brain. Bring common sense to what the AI is doing. Spot anything that looks wrong or unusual, help it get past blockers, and check that it's following its routines and doing its repeat work reliably.

• The hands. Make and take phone calls, make judgement calls, and do the things a person can do more easily, quickly or better, including the times when a personal, human touch matters.



AI will assist and lead the work, but the right person will always be an important part of how we operate. You don't need to be a UK property expert. You do need to be dependable and switched on, and comfortable working with AI tools.



What we're looking for, honestly. We hire a person for what AI can't do well: real judgement, overseeing the AI and spotting its gaps and mistakes, and being a real human voice on the phone. People like knowing there's a person behind our messages. We'll be judging this. If someone would only be doing what an AI could do, it won't be the right fit. We want someone who enjoys working alongside AI and filling its gaps, not someone frustrated by it.



When we need you

This is ad hoc work, not a fixed shift. Most weeks it's somewhere between 2 and 15 hours, depending on what's going on with the properties (lettings, viewings, repairs) and with the owner's personal admin and travel. Many of our best candidates have another job or clients, and that's fine.



What matters is that you stay reachable through the UK day, from your phone and your computer (we're busiest roughly 9am–5:30pm UK time, which is 5pm–1:30am Philippine time in UK winter), and that you triage well. An
 often doesn't need an answer for hours. A tenant WhatsApp may need a reply in minutes. A viewer phoning because they can't find the property needs you now. Judging what needs what response, while you get on with your day, is the core skill.



Phone calls. This isn't a call-heavy job. We encourage everyone to use WhatsApp and
, and the more responsive you are there, the fewer calls you'll get. But some calls can't wait, and these are the times you must keep your phone close:



• Viewing blocks, for example 90 minutes of back-to-back viewings, when people may have access problems, need the full address, or call to make an offer.

• Access windows, when a contractor or cleaner is going into a property and a tenant needs to let them in.



You'll usually know about these windows in advance. We're also planning to add an AI that answers calls first, deals with the simple ones, takes messages for non-urgent ones, and only puts through the calls that need a person.



The most important thing is good triage and reliable responsiveness: seeing things quickly on WhatsApp and
, judging what needs action now and what can wait, and being by the phone during the windows we agree in advance.



Weekend work is occasional, mainly messages with the owner, a viewing day, a tenant issue, or helping with his personal plans. You'll usually know in advance when you need to be especially available. Work comes in short bursts of ad hoc tasks, not long fixed shifts.



What we provide



• A work phone number on a VoIP app that rings on both your phone and your computer. We pay for the line. You'll use it to call UK numbers and to take incoming calls.

• WhatsApp, which we use heavily for messaging.

• Google Workspace, and AI agents to brief you and draft for you.



What you'll do



• Phone calls to UK numbers: contractors such as plumbers, electricians and other trades, letting agents, suppliers, utility companies, councils (when approved) and tenants. You'll get a short brief before each call and report back afterwards on what was agreed.

• Incoming calls on the work number when needed, such as during viewings or access windows.

• Messaging tenants, applicants and contractors by WhatsApp and
, following our scripts and rules.

• Arranging contractors and viewings: booking slots, confirming access and attendance, and chasing.

• Following up: making sure what was promised actually happens (repairs, quotes, documents, payments), and flagging it when it doesn't.

• Overseeing the AI: checking its drafts, lists and records, making sure it keeps to its routines, and speaking up when something looks off.

• Light admin: filing and simple updates in Google Sheets and Docs.

• Personal assistant tasks for the owner: booking appointments, calling companies on his behalf, chasing deliveries and refunds, and other everyday admin.



Requirements



• Good spoken English. You'll need to be clear and confident on UK phone calls and able to follow UK accents.

• Good written English for messages and notes (the AI agents help with drafting).

• Connected through the day on both mobile and desktop (WhatsApp and our VoIP work number on both), quick to judge what needs a fast reply, and able to take calls during agreed viewing and access windows.

• Reliable internet with a backup for power or internet cuts (e.g. mobile data, UPS or inverter), a quiet place to take calls, a headset, and a smartphone and computer that can run a VoIP app.

• Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and happy to work alongside AI tools.

• Common sense, and the confidence to flag things that don't look right.

• Discreet and trustworthy, because you'll handle people's personal information.

• Organised, with clear notes recording who said what, when, and any dates and amounts.



Nice to have (not required)



• Experience in UK property or lettings, real estate VA work, or customer service.

• Experience making calls to UK or US businesses.

• Experience with OpenRent, SpareRoom, Rightmove or similar.

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or similar at work.



How to apply

We read every application that follows these steps. Applications that skip any step won't be considered.



• Subject line: start it with KETTLE ON – [your first name] so we know you've read this post.

• Availability: tell us when you're usually reachable, in UK time, Monday to Sunday. If you have another job or clients (that's fine), tell us their hours and how you'd keep an eye on WhatsApp and
 around them. Could you keep your phone free for a pre-arranged 60–90 minute window, such as a viewing block, on most weekdays?

• Voice recording (required, 1–2 minutes): send a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo or similar) to a natural recording that isn't read from a script. In it: (a) introduce yourself and say when you're available in UK time; and (b) act out this call in your own words. You're phoning a plumber for a landlord client about a leaking kitchen tap at one of his rental flats. Find out their earliest availability this week and their call-out charge, and explain that the tenant can give access after 2pm.

• Short written answers, in your own words:

   – (a) Tell us about a time you had to chase someone who kept missing a deadline. What did you do?

   – (b) Tell us about a time you spotted a mistake someone else (or a tool) had made. What did you do about it?

   – (c) What's your typical response time on WhatsApp during your available hours, and how would you handle an incoming work call while you're busy with something else?

   – (d) What internet speed do you have, and what's your backup if the power or internet goes down?

   – (e) What is your expected rate (US$ or £ per hour)?

• Your CV.



Pay and start: you'll be paid by the hour, at your agreed rate, for the work you do. There's no retainer and no minimum hours. You'll keep a simple log of your tasks and time and bill from it. We'd prefer an immediate start, but we can be flexible.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short paid test task and a 20-minute call that includes a quick phone role-play.



Individuals only. No agencies or automation services, please.

title: Amazon Product Research Assistant (Storefronts & Background Research, EU) - 2 positions
description:
GTDISTRIBUTION sells on Amazon across Europe (FR, DE, IT, ES, NL, BE). We are hiring 2 full-time product researchers. Your work d
 what we buy, so we are looking for people who are exact, patient and independent.



What you will do

- Open the Amazon storefronts of other sellers and go through their products

- For each product, check price history, sales rank, monthly sales, number of sellers and fees

- Match the exact same product (same EAN, size, pack and version) and find where it can be bought in Europe

- Calculate the ROI and give one clear verdict per line: yes, no or maybe, with the reason

- Re-check the products already in our Google Sheet and flag price drops and changes

- Send a short daily report: products checked / validated / what blocked you



What you will not do

Product research only. No contact with suppliers, no orders, no access to our accounts. Other team members handle that.



Who we want

- Good written English

- Strong with Google Sheets or Excel, comfortable with numbers

- A background in research, purchasing, supply chain or data analysis is welcome. Amazon experience (Keepa, SellerAmp, ProfitPath) is a plus, not required: we train you

- You try to solve a problem yourself first, then you ask with what you already tried



Pay and schedule

- PHP 28,000 to 32,000 per month base, depending on experience, plus a monthly performance bonus based on validated products

- Full time, Monday to Friday

- One fixed daily window: 9:00 to 12:00 CET (16:00 to 19:00 Philippine time), the rest of the day is flexible

- Long-term role: people who deliver get more responsibility over time



How to apply (we read every answer, applications that skip this are rejected)

Start your message with the word STOREFRONT. Answer in your own words, we will ask you to explain your answers on a call. Copy-pasted or AI-written answers are rejected.



1. A storefront shows a shampoo, pack of 3, sold at 39.90 EUR on Amazon FR (VAT included), about 25 sales per month, 4 sellers. A French retail site sells the same shampoo as a single bottle at 8.90 EUR, and as a bundle of 3 at 24.90 EUR (VAT included). Amazon fees are about 28% of the selling price. Tell us: what you check to confirm it is the same product, your ROI with the calculation shown, and your verdict with 2 risks.



2. You find a product you are 80% sure matches an Amazon listing, but the retail site shows no EAN. List what you try, in order, before asking anyone. Then say at which point you would ask for help.



Also include: your expected monthly salary, your start date, and a link to your CV.

title: Hiring: SEO Content Writer – Remote
description:
**Position:** SEO Content Writer  

**Job Type:** Full-Time | Remote (Work From Home)  

**Location:** Philippines  

**Salary:**  (depending on experience)  

**Working Hours:** 45 hours per week  

**Industry:** SEO / Digital Marketing / 

## About the Role



We are looking for a skilled, creative, and detail-oriented **SEO Content Writer** to join our growing SEO team.



The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, a good understanding of search engine optimisation (SEO), and the ability to produce engaging, well-researched, and original content that performs well in search engines.



You will be responsible for writing SEO-optimised blog articles, website landing pages, product descriptions, and other content designed to improve organic search visibility, attract relevant traffic, and support our overall SEO strategy.





## Key Responsibilities



### 1. SEO Content Writing

- Write original, high-quality, SEO-optimised blog posts, articles, landing pages, and website content.

- Create informative, engaging, and easy-to-read content that matches the target audience's search intent.

- Follow provided content briefs, target keywords, article outlines, and editorial guidelines.

- Write compelling page titles, meta descriptions, headings, and introductory paragraphs.

- Naturally incorporate primary and secondary keywords without keyword stuffing.

- Maintain consistent tone, style, and messaging across different pages and content types.



### 2. Keyword Research & Content Optimisation

- Conduct basic keyword research and identify relevant topics and keyword opportunities.

- Understand search intent and organise content around the questions and needs of the target audience.

- Review competing articles and search results to identify content gaps and opportunities.

- Structure articles using appropriate headings (H1, H2, H3), internal links, and relevant references.

- Optimise existing articles and landing pages to improve readability, relevance, and organic search performance.

- Apply SEO best practices, including content structure, keyword placement, and on-page optimisation.



### 3. Content Research & Quality Assurance

- Research topics thoroughly using credible and relevant sources.

- Verify facts, statistics, product details, and other important claims before publication.

- Ensure all submitted content is original, accurate, grammatically correct, and free from plagiarism.

- Edit and proofread content before submission.

- Avoid repetitive, generic, overly promotional, or unnatural writing.

- Ensure content complies with editorial guidelines and applicable content policies.



### 4. Content Management & Reporting

- Organise content assignments and monitor deadlines.

- Maintain content trackers using Google Sheets or similar tools.

- Coordinate with the SEO team regarding content briefs, revisions, and optimisation requirements.

- Update existing articles when information becomes outdated.

- Provide regular progress reports on assigned writing tasks.

- Incorporate editorial feedback and complete revisions when necessary.



## Qualifications



**Required:**

- At least 1 year of experience in content writing, SEO writing, copywriting, or a related field.

- Excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.

- Ability to write natural, clear, engaging, and informative content.

- Basic understanding of SEO principles, keyword placement, and search intent.

- Strong online research, editing, and proofreading skills.

- Ability to follow content briefs and meet deadlines consistently.

- Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.



**Preferred but Not Required:**

- Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, or other SEO tools.

- Familiarity with WordPress or other content management systems.

- Understanding of internal linking, content clusters, and topical authority.

- Familiarity with Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).

- Experience updating existing content based on SEO performance data.



## Content Quality Expectations



We are looking for writers who can produce content that sounds natural, informative, and genuinely useful.



**We do not want articles that sound obviously AI-generated.**



AI tools may be used to assist with research, brainstorming, or proofreading when permitted, but writers must take responsibility for the originality, accuracy, and overall quality of their work.



Content must demonstrate:

- Natural, fluent English and clear communication.

- Strong understanding of the topic and target audience.

- Original insights and useful information.

- Well-organised paragraphs and logical structure.

- Appropriate keyword usage without unnecessary repetition.

- Minimal filler, generic statements, and repetitive phrasing.

- Accurate information and reliable research.



What we offer:

- Fully remote work arrangement.

- Consistent writing assignments.

- Clear content briefs and SEO guidance.

- Opportunity to develop advanced SEO, AEO, and GEO writing skills.

- Professional growth within an SEO and digital marketing team.

- Performance-based salary reviews.



## How to Apply



Interested applicants should submit the following:



1. Updated resume or CV.

2. A brief introduction describing your writing experience.

3. Links to at least 2–3 previously published articles or writing samples.

4. A short description of your SEO knowledge and tools you have used.

5. Your expected monthly salary.

6. Your earliest available start date.



### Writing Assessment



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid writing assessment to evaluate their research, writing style, SEO understanding, and ability to follow a content brief.



We value writers who can produce clear, helpful, and original content over those who simply generate large volumes of articles.



**Application Subject:** SEO Content Writer Application – [Your Name]



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:

**Department:** Digital Marketing & Content Strategy  

**Position:** Social Media & Digital Growth Manager



## Position Overview



We are seeking a creative, highly organized, analytical, and results-driven Social Media & Digital Growth Manager to oversee the development, execution, and optimization of social media and digital marketing strategies for our company and its clients.



This individual will be responsible for managing social media accounts, developing content calendars, coordinating content production, growing online communities, increasing engagement, and driving measurable audience growth.



Beyond traditional social media management, the ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience building and launching webinars, developing high-converting sales funnels, managing paid advertising campaigns, and implementing marketing automation strategies.



Our objective is to transform compelling content into a powerful marketing ecosystem that builds brand authority, generates qualified leads, converts followers into customers, and drives measurable business growth.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Social Media Management & Strategy



- Develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies aligned with each client's brand identity, audience, marketing objectives, and business goals.

- Manage day-to-day operations across Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.

- Create, maintain, and execute weekly and monthly social media content calendars.

- Schedule, publish, and optimize content across all assigned accounts, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and timely delivery.

- Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously while maintaining each brand's unique voice, messaging, and visual identity.

- Write compelling captions, headlines, descriptions, hashtags, and calls to action tailored to each platform.

- Optimize social media profiles, bios, links, highlights, playlists, and other channel elements for discoverability and conversion.

- Stay current with platform algorithms, content trends, emerging features, and digital marketing best practices.

- Identify strategic opportunities to expand audience reach, improve engagement, and strengthen brand positioning.

- Ensure all published content meets established quality standards and receives required client approvals.



### 2. Content Development & Production Coordination



- Collaborate with producers, videographers, video editors, graphic designers, and content strategists to develop engaging multimedia content.

- Transform podcasts, interviews, webinars, and long-form videos into compelling short-form social media content.

- Develop content strategies for Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, carousels, static graphics, Stories, and other digital formats.

- Identify high-impact moments from long-form recordings that can be repurposed into engaging and shareable content.

- Develop creative briefs and provide direction to editors and designers regarding content objectives, messaging, formatting, and platform requirements.

- Create and manage content publishing workflows, including asset organization, approvals, scheduling, and quality control.

- Ensure content is optimized for each platform, including thumbnails, hooks, titles, captions, aspect ratios, and calls to action.

- Monitor performance to identify successful content themes and recommend new content opportunities.

- Coordinate content supporting product launches, webinars, campaigns, events, and promotional initiatives.



### 3. Community Management & Audience Engagement



- Monitor and manage comments, direct messages, mentions, and audience interactions across assigned social media platforms.

- Develop community engagement strategies that encourage meaningful conversations and strengthen audience relationships.

- Respond to audience inquiries professionally and in accordance with established brand guidelines.

- Identify potential customers, collaborators, and partnership opportunities emerging from social media engagement.

- Implement engagement strategies designed to increase shares, saves, comments, profile visits, and audience retention.

- Manage audience interactions related to promotions, webinar registrations, product launches, and marketing campaigns.

- Utilize approved direct-message automation tools, such as ManyChat, to support lead generation and customer engagement.

- Monitor brand sentiment and identify potential reputation management concerns.



### 4. Social Media Growth & Optimization



- Develop strategies to increase followers, impressions, reach, engagement, video views, and qualified audience growth.

- Analyze audience demographics, behavior, and content preferences to refine platform strategies.

- Optimize YouTube content through effective titles, thumbnails, descriptions, keywords, playlists, and audience retention analysis.

- Identify opportunities for collaborations, influencer partnerships, and cross-platform promotion.

- Conduct competitive analysis to identify emerging trends, successful content approaches, and growth opportunities.

- Test content formats, publishing schedules, creative approaches, and calls to action to maximize performance.

- Build strategies that move audiences from social platforms into owned marketing channels, including
 lists, webinar registrations, and customer communities.



### 5. Webinar Development, Launch & Management



- Plan, build, launch, and manage live and evergreen webinars designed to educate audiences, generate leads, and drive product sales.

- Develop complete webinar promotional campaigns utilizing organic social media, paid advertising,
 marketing, and SMS communications.

- Create and optimize webinar registration pages, confirmation pages, reminder sequences, and post-event follow-up communications.

- Coordinate webinar schedules, promotional assets, registration systems, technical setup, and campaign execution.

- Work with clients and presenters to develop compelling webinar messaging, offers, presentations, and conversion strategies.

- Manage platforms such as Zoom Webinars, WebinarJam, EverWebinar, GoHighLevel, or similar solutions.

- Develop strategies for paid workshops, multi-day challenges, masterclasses, and digital product launches.

- Analyze webinar performance, including registration rates, attendance rates, audience retention, offer conversion rates, cost per registrant, and revenue.

- Optimize webinar campaigns based on measurable performance data.



### 6. Sales Funnel Development & Marketing Automation



- Design, build, launch, and optimize sales funnels that convert social media audiences into qualified leads and paying customers.

- Develop lead-generation funnels, webinar funnels, challenge funnels, product launch funnels, and evergreen marketing campaigns.

- Build landing pages, opt-in forms, sales pages, checkout pages, and thank-you pages.

- Create automated
 and SMS sequences for lead nurturing, webinar attendance, abandoned checkout recovery, and post-purchase engagement.

- Integrate social media campaigns with CRM systems,

- Utilize platforms such as GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Kajabi, HubSpot, or similar tools.

- Implement segmentation, lead tagging, workflow triggers, and customer journey automation.

- Develop conversion strategies for low-ticket digital products, mid-ticket programs, and high-ticket coaching, consulting, and educational offers.

- Continuously monitor and improve funnel conversion rates.



### 7. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management



- Develop, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Create paid advertising strategies supporting brand awareness, content distribution, audience growth, lead generation, webinar registrations, and product sales.

- Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, retargeting strategies, ad placements, and creative testing.

- Develop advertising copy and collaborate with creative teams to produce high-performing ad assets.

- Analyze underperforming campaigns and develop corrective action plans.

- Present clear, actionable recommendations to internal leadership and clients.

- Connect digital marketing activity to measurable business results, including lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue.



### 9. Client Communication & Project Management



- Serve as a key point of contact for assigned clients regarding social media execution and digital marketing campaign performance.

- Participate in client strategy meetings, content planning sessions, and campaign reviews.

- Maintain organized workflows and clearly communicate deliverables, deadlines, priorities, and approvals.

- Coordinate with internal production, editing, design, and marketing teams to ensure timely execution.

- Manage multiple client campaigns without compromising quality or consistency.

- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, standardized processes, and emerging technologies.

title: Finance & Franchise Performance Manager (Xero)
description:
Finance & Franchise Performance Manager (Xero)

 

Company: Samba Soccer Schools Global Ltd

 

Location: Remote – Philippines

 

Salary: $800 USD per month 

 

Working Days: Monday–Friday

 

Working Hours: 6:00am–3:00pm UK time (2:00pm–11:00pm Philippine time), including a 1-hour break.

 

Position: Full-time, long-term, exclusive — we will be your only client.

 

ABOUT SAMBA SOCCER SCHOOLS

 

Samba Soccer Schools is a growing UK-based children's football coaching organisation. We have coached over 20,000 children across London in the last 15 years, and we are now expanding across the UK through both our company-owned operating business and a network of independently operated franchise businesses.

 

As our franchise network continues to expand, we are looking for an experienced, proactive and commercially minded finance professional to join our team.

 

This person will be responsible for supporting the financial operations of both our main operating business and our franchise network, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, effective financial management, consistent reporting and strong financial performance.

 

You will work closely with the Managing Director, our UK accountants and individual franchise partners.

 

This is not simply a bookkeeping or data-entry position.

 

We want someone who understands how businesses operate financially, can interpret financial information, identify problems early, recommend improvements and help franchise partners become more financially successful.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

1. MAIN OPERATING BUSINESS – FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT

 

You will help manage the day-to-day financial operations of Samba Soccer Schools' main operating business.

 

Responsibilities include:

 

Maintaining accurate bookkeeping records using Xero.

 

Completing monthly bank reconciliations.

 

Monitoring revenue, expenditure, invoices and supplier payments.

 

Tracking accounts payable and receivable.

 

Monitoring company cash flow and preparing forecasts.

 

Reviewing monthly profit and loss statements.

 

Tracking budgets and identifying overspending.

 

Monitoring recurring costs, subscriptions and supplier expenses.

 

Identifying cost-saving opportunities.

 

Preparing weekly and monthly financial summaries for the Managing Director.

 

Working with our external UK accountants to ensure accurate financial records and compliance, including preparing the workings for VAT returns for their review.

 

2. FRANCHISE NETWORK – MONTHLY BOOKKEEPING

 

You will also be responsible for managing and coordinating the monthly bookkeeping requirements across our growing network of franchise businesses.

 

Responsibilities include:

 

Maintaining bookkeeping records for individual franchisees using Xero.

 

Completing monthly bank reconciliations for franchise businesses.

 

Ensuring income and expenditure are correctly categorised.

 

Reviewing transactions and investigating discrepancies.

 

Monitoring outstanding invoices and financial commitments.

 

Ensuring bookkeeping is completed accurately and on time each month.

 

Maintaining consistent charts of accounts across franchise businesses.

 

Working with our external accountants to ensure records are accurate and ready for statutory and tax reporting.

 

Each franchise must have accurate, organised and up-to-date financial information.

 

3. FRANCHISE FINANCIAL ONBOARDING

 

When new franchise partners join Samba Soccer Schools, you will take responsibility for supporting the financial onboarding process.

 

This includes:

 

Guiding franchisees through the financial setup of their businesses.

 

Coordinating the setup and configuration of Xero.

 

Ensuring the correct chart of accounts is implemented.

 

Supporting the setup of bank feeds and accounting processes.

 

Explaining how franchisees should manage income, expenditure and financial records.

 

Educating new franchisees on bookkeeping responsibilities and financial procedures.

 

Ensuring each franchise follows our standardised reporting structure.

 

Liaising with franchisees and accountants to resolve financial setup issues.

 

Our goal is for every franchise partner to start their business with the correct financial systems, processes and understanding in place.

 

4. FRANCHISE FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE MONITORING

 

A major part of this role involves actively monitoring the financial performance of our franchise network.

 

You will:

 

Review monthly revenue, operating costs and profitability for each franchise.

 

Monitor profit margins and overall financial health.

 

Compare actual results against budgets and forecasts.

 

Identify franchisees experiencing financial difficulties.

 

Monitor trends in revenue, expenses and profitability.

 

Analyse venue-level profitability where data is available.

 

Identify unnecessary costs and opportunities to improve financial performance.

 

Track outstanding franchise fees, royalties and other financial obligations.

 

Produce meaningful financial insights and recommendations.

 

We want someone who can look at financial reports and explain what the numbers mean, why performance is changing and what action should be taken.

 

5. MONTHLY FRANCHISE FINANCIAL REPORTING

 

You will be responsible for preparing and distributing monthly financial performance reports to franchise partners.

 

Each report should provide a clear overview of the franchise's financial performance, including:

 

Monthly revenue.

 

Operating expenditure.

 

Gross and net profitability.

 

Profit margins.

 

Cash-flow position.

 

Performance against budgets or previous periods.

 

Significant changes in income or expenditure.

 

Areas of financial concern.

 

Recommendations to improve profitability.

 

Reports must be accurate, easy to understand and consistent across the franchise network.

 

You will also provide the Managing Director with a consolidated overview of franchise financial performance.

 

6. FINANCIAL EDUCATION & FRANCHISE SUPPORT

 

We want our franchise partners to become financially knowledgeable and capable business owners.

 

You will play an important role in developing their financial understanding and commercial awareness.

 

Responsibilities include:

 

Helping franchisees understand their profit and loss statements.

 

Explaining the difference between revenue, profit and cash flow.

 

Educating franchisees on budgeting and financial planning.

 

Helping franchisees understand their operating costs and profit margins.

 

Explaining how to identify unnecessary expenditure.

 

Supporting franchisees with financial questions.

 

Helping franchisees understand how financial decisions affect profitability.

 

Providing practical recommendations to improve business performance.

 

You must be confident explaining financial concepts in simple, clear English to people who may not have an accounting background.

 

7. EARLY IDENTIFICATION OF FINANCIAL PROBLEMS

 

One of the most important responsibilities of this position is identifying financial problems before they become serious.

 

You will be expected to proactively monitor the finances of both our operating business and franchise network.

 

Examples include:

 

A franchise consistently operating at a loss.

 

Rapidly increasing operating costs.

 

Significant reductions in revenue.

 

Poor cash-flow management.

 

Unpaid invoices or overdue financial obligations.

 

Unusual transactions or financial discrepancies.

 

Potential cash shortages.

 

Franchisees spending beyond their available budgets.

 

Unexpected changes in profitability.

 

Any significant financial concern must be flagged directly to the Managing Director as early as possible, together with an explanation of the issue and recommended actions.

 

We do not want someone who simply reports financial problems after they have happened.

 

We want someone proactive who can anticipate risks and help prevent them.

 

8. FINANCIAL REPORTING & MANAGEMENT DASHBOARDS

 

You will also help develop and maintain financial reporting systems for the wider business.

 

This includes:

 

Preparing monthly management accounts.

 

Maintaining cash-flow forecasts.

 

Creating Excel or Google Sheets financial dashboards.

 

Monitoring key financial performance indicators.

 

Producing weekly financial summaries for management.

 

Comparing performance across franchise businesses.

 

Identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

 

Supporting the Managing Director with financial analysis and business decisions.

 

We are an AI-forward business: we use modern AI tools throughout our financial workflows, and we will train you on our systems. An interest in working this way is important.

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 

Minimum 2–3 years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience.

 

Previous experience supporting UK businesses, including familiarity with UK VAT and UK accounting practices.

 

Strong hands-on experience using Xero.

 

Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients.

 

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

 

Ability to prepare and interpret profit and loss statements, balance sheets and cash-flow reports.

 

Experience with bank reconciliations and monthly financial reporting.

 

Good understanding of budgeting, profitability and cash-flow management.

 

Excellent written and spoken English.

 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 

Excellent attention to detail.

 

Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and take ownership of responsibilities.

 

HIGHLY DESIRABLE

 

Accounting qualification (CPA) or relevant university degree.

 

Experience at an outsourcing/BPO firm serving UK accounting practices.

 

Experience working with franchise businesses or multi-location companies.

 

Experience preparing management accounts and financial dashboards.

 

Experience supporting business owners with financial planning.

 

Experience training or explaining financial concepts to non-finance professionals.

 

THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

We are looking for someone who is:

 

Highly organised, reliable and trustworthy.

 

Confident working with financial information.

 

Proactive rather than reactive.

 

Commercially minded and interested in business performance.

 

Comfortable communicating directly with business owners.

 

Able to explain complicated financial information simply.

 

Confident identifying problems and recommending solutions.

 

Capable of managing multiple businesses and deadlines.

 

Interested in building a long-term career with our company.

 

We value initiative, ownership and accountability.

 

If you notice a problem, we want you to raise it.

 

If you identify an opportunity to improve profitability, we want you to recommend it.

 

If a franchise partner is struggling financially, we want you to help them understand why and what they can do about it.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 

$800 USD monthly salary, paid monthly via Wise.

 

Salary reviews after 6 and 12 months, based on performance.

 

Consistent full-time Monday–Friday schedule on a standard Philippine mid shift (2:00pm–11:00pm).

 

Long-term opportunity with a growing UK company.

 

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director.

 

Opportunity to work across multiple businesses.

 

Exposure to franchise operations and business financial management.

 

Clear potential for career progression as the franchise network grows.

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Please answer the following questions when submitting your application:

 

1. How many years of bookkeeping or accounting experience do you have?

 

2. How many years have you used Xero professionally?

 

3. Have you managed bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients simultaneously?

 

4. Describe your experience working with UK-based businesses, including any UK VAT work.

 

5. Can you independently prepare monthly management accounts, profit and loss statements and cash-flow forecasts?

 

6. Have you ever monitored the financial performance of a business and recommended improvements? Give a brief example.

 

7. Are you comfortable explaining financial reports to business owners who do not have an accounting background?

 

8. Have you supported the financial onboarding or accounting setup of new businesses?

 

9. This is a full-time, exclusive role. Are you able to commit 100% of your working time to us, with no other clients?

 

10. Are you available to work 2:00pm–11:00pm Philippine time (6:00am–3:00pm UK time), Monday–Friday?

 

11. Are you happy with the salary of $800 USD per month pay?

 

12. When would you be available to start?

 

Please attach your CV and, if possible, an anonymised example of a financial report or dashboard you have previously prepared.

 

IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "SAMBA FINANCE" so we know you have read the full job description.

 

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an online interview and a paid practical finance assessment using real (anonymised) company data.

 

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior SEO Specialist – Shopify Migration Recovery & Ongoing Optimization (Long-Term) – SewingMachinesPlus.com
description:
is an established Shopify store selling sewing machines, fabric, and related products. In February we migrated our store to Shopify, and our organic traffic and keyword rankings have fallen off a cliff since. Pages that used to drive strong traffic lost their rankings, redirects were not mapped correctly, and the site still has broken, thin, and duplicate pages hurting indexation and crawl efficiency.



We need a senior, hands-on SEO specialist with deep technical SEO and migration recovery experience who can understand everything that went wrong post-migration and get our rankings and traffic back. This is a long-term position, but we want to start with a focused recovery sprint: a lot of hours up front for the right person who can show they can get the site back up.



Phase 1 – Audit and recovery plan (first step):

- Run a full technical SEO audit and migration analysis of the site at the start, so we are all on the same page and have a clear, prioritized plan

- Compare pre- and post-migration URLs, traffic, and keyword rankings (Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, Wayback/old sitemaps) to find exactly what was lost and why

- Deliver a written recovery roadmap with priorities, timelines, and expected impact



What you will do:

- Build and implement a complete 301 redirect map so every old URL points to the right new page (no redirect chains, loops, or soft 404s)

- Find and fix crawl errors, 404s, broken internal links, orphan pages, and duplicate or thin content

- Clean up indexation: XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, noindex rules, and Google Search Console coverage issues

- Reorganize site architecture, collection structure, and internal linking so authority flows to our most important pages

- Check domain, DNS, and HTTPS/www setup for misconfigurations affecting crawling or indexing

- On-page optimization: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, collection and product page copy, image alt text, and structured data (schema)

- Keyword recovery and keyword mapping for collection and product pages

- Review the backlink profile and recover lost link equity from old URLs

- Improve Core Web Vitals and page speed where they affect rankings

- Track and report weekly on rankings, organic traffic, indexation, and progress against the plan



What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with strong technical SEO skills

- Proven Shopify SEO experience, including at least one platform migration or migration recovery (please name the site)

- Expert with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and a crawler such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb

- Deep understanding of 301 redirects, redirect mapping, canonicalization, indexation, and site architecture

- Strong on-page SEO and e-commerce keyword research skills

- Clear written English and the ability to explain issues and plans in plain language

- Available for heavy hours during the initial recovery sprint, then steady long-term work



How to apply:

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, include:

1. One real before/after SEO result, with the site name, ideally a migration or traffic recovery

2. Your Shopify SEO experience and the tools you use

3. How you would approach the first week of auditing a site whose traffic dropped after a migration

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a small paid test task.

title: AI-Assisted Customer Support Specialist <email class=
description:
➤ Who we are

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand selling to women in the US, Canada and the UK. Orders are growing fast. Our support team has two full-time agents today, and the volume now needs more.

We are not the average e-commerce brand that stops caring once the order is paid. We want every customer happy, and a brand reputation that is spotless. That is why this role matters to us.



➤ This is not a typing job. It's a thinking job.

Customer support here is not about writing replies anymore. Our AI drafts the replies, and most of them are already very good.

Your job is to think: read every draft, check the order and the facts, fix what's wrong, and d
 what gets sent. You will work with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) all day. We need a sharp brain, not a fast typist.

And you own your queue. Every customer gets an answer. Every order problem gets followed until it is solved. Nothing gets forgotten. You don't need anyone to remind you.



➤ The team and your shift

Support here runs around the clock, in three 8-hour shifts (Philippine time):

• Afternoon and evening: 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM

• Graveyard: 9:00 PM to 5:00 AM

• Morning: 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM

In the application form, tell us every shift you can work. We agree on yours together, and then it stays fixed.

Whatever your shift, the job is the same:

• You own the queue while you are on. Every customer gets an answer, every order problem gets followed.

• On the days one of your teammates is off, you carry a bigger part of the queue.

• Before you log off, you brief the next agent: what happened, what is open, what to watch.



➤ What you will do

Customers always come first: support and comments are your priority every day. Supplier follow-ups fill the rest of your shift, and creator partnerships come later.



1. Customer support 
, AI-assisted)

• Review every AI-drafted reply in our inbox (Help Scout): check the order in Shopify and the tracking, correct or rewrite with AI when needed, then send.

• Handle order status, shipping delays, returns, refunds, exchanges and address changes.

• Handle sensitive cases calmly: upset customers, disputes and chargebacks.

• Spot when the AI gets something wrong, and report it so the system keeps getting better.



2. Social media moderation

• Check comments on our
 and Instagram pages and ads, every day.

• Reply, hide spam, and turn public complaints into solved tickets.



3. Supplier and fulfillment follow-up

• Follow up with our supplier and fulfillment partners on delayed, lost or wrong orders.

• Make sure every stuck order gets a solution, and the customer hears about it.



4. Content creator partnerships (later, as the role grows)

• We are starting to work with content creators and influencers. It is close to customer support: you write to people, answer their questions, and follow up until it is done.

• Reach out to creators, coordinate product shipments, and track the content we receive.

• This is not for day one. It comes when support is under control and you have time in your shift.



➤ Schedule

• Full time, 6 days a week. One fixed day off, agreed together. It cannot be Saturday, Sunday or Monday.

• One fixed shift, agreed together (see the three shifts above): 8 hours with 1 hour of breaks inside, so 7 hours of work a day. No split shift.

• The shift can move by one hour when the US changes its clocks.

• Being open to a 7th day during peak season is a big plus (paid extra).

• 100% remote, from the South East Asia time zone (Philippines preferred). Fast, reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages.

• Start: as soon as possible.



➤ Who you are

• Must have: 2+ years of customer support for an e-commerce brand on Shopify. This is required.

• Must have: you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) regularly. If you don't use AI today, this role is not for you. We will train you on our system.

• A sharp, analytical mind: you read carefully, check the facts, and catch mistakes, including the AI's.

• Excellent written English: warm, clear and professional.

• Organized and detail-oriented. To prove it: in the application form, start your answer about the Shopify brands you supported with the word banana.

• Responsible. You follow up without being reminded, and you bring solutions, not only problems.

• Experience with a helpdesk (Help Scout, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar).

• Experience with
 and Instagram comment moderation.

• Bonus: experience talking to suppliers or fulfillment partners.

• Bonus: experience with influencer or content creator (UGC) outreach.



➤ What's in it for you

💰 $1,000 a month, paid on time, twice a month.

📊 Performance bonuses.

🕐 A fixed shift, chosen with you. No split shift, no schedule that changes every week.

🚀 Room to grow: more responsibility and a higher salary as the brand grows.

🤝 A long-term, stable role with a brand that is actively scaling.

👤 Direct work with the founder, in a small team that already runs well.



Status: independent contractor. The salary is gross, and you handle your own taxes.

I am looking for someone with a brain, who takes responsibility. My goal is simple: within a few weeks, you are 100% autonomous. I don't double-check your work, because you handle it and I trust you. Every
 and every comment gets answered on time, every day. Nothing gets forgotten. If there is a problem, I hear about it from you first.

title: US Tax Manager
description:

Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.
