*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:

title: DTC Creative Strategist & DR Copywriter (Supplements, Native Ads)
description:
We're looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to join our team on a long-term, full-time contract! As our creative strategist, you'll own the ideation, research, copywriting, planning and management of the entire creative process, with a heavy focus on native image ads, Meta VSLs, UGC ads and high-converting direct response ads (short and long form) that scale across our paid channels. We spend $100,000 to $300,000 per month on Meta. We're looking for someone with 3+ years of experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience in health and wellness, is a proven native ad killer, runs a current AI stack in production, has experience briefing short and long form VSLs, and delivers volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.





WHO ARE WE?



We're a premium DTC supplement brand and one of the fastest-growing brands in our space: $300,000 to $400,000 per month in revenue and targeting 8 figures in 2027. We recently launched a new product line and are expanding into new customer avatars. We have our own in-house AI creative app for scripting, revisions and production, so your ideas get tested fast. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.





WHAT IS OUR CULTURE LIKE & WHO IS A GOOD FIT?



Hunger is our #1 factor when hiring. We have a genuine will to win, and no work is beneath us if it moves the brand forward. We're results-first: we care about what you ship and what it does, not when you're online. We make decisions with data, and we treat every problem as a chance to learn and get better.



If you want a comfortable, stress-free 9-5, this isn't it.



If you want to own creative at a brand that's scaling, work directly with the founder bouncing ideas back and forth every day, see huge career growth by playing a big part in scaling it to 8 figures, drive results without politics or corporate red tape, and make as much money as humanly possible doing it... then you've come to the right place.





KEY OBJECTIVES



• Manage the full creative process, from research and scripting all the way to final creative, to produce high-converting creatives on an ongoing basis

• Drive measurable improvements in our core advertising metrics through better creative

• Write all direct response copy: primary texts, hooks, VSL and UGC scripts, advertorials, listicles and product pages

• Run the full native image ad workflow, from the copy to the images

• Use performance data from Meta to dissect, analyze and iterate on our creatives so performance keeps improving

• Come up with new angles, mechanisms and concepts together with the founder

• Conduct strategic customer and competitor research: Meta Ad Library, reviews, Reddit, forums and X

• Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis

• D
 on the next steps needed to scale Meta further through better creative

• Produce a minimum of 15 new ads per week, maintaining volume and quality at the same time, without being chased





REQUIREMENTS



• Fully remote, independent contractor role: full-time commitment with complete flexibility on working hours

• Fluent in English

• Direct Response Expertise: 3+ years of performance creative for DTC health, wellness or supplement brands, or at a creative agency, is a must

• Native Killer: you've written native ads, advertorials and listicles that scaled, and you can show them

• Proven VSL copywriting experience on direct response / performance brands

• Meta VSLs: proven experience with both short and long form Meta VSLs

• Deep DTC Experience: you can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work, not just categories

• Strong analytical skills: hands-on experience reading performance data in Meta Ads Manager and attribution tools, and using spreadsheets and reporting tools to pull insights, inform strategy and communicate results

• You understand the levels of awareness and actually apply them

• Chronically Online: you naturally spend your time on X and scrolling through the Ad Library

• AI Stack: you run a current AI stack in production, not one you tried once

• Output: you deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased

• No issue putting in extra hours or weekends when needed. You're passionate about your work and wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you worked less

• Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and to work closely with the founder

• Deep fluency with DTC and modern consumer brands

• Growth Mindset: you're open to feedback and always learning. If you don't have the hunger and drive in you, don't apply.





EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Develop native ads end-to-end: angle, hook, primary text and images

• Develop VSL briefings end-to-end: angle, hook, script, structure

• Design AI-driven concepts and hooks for paid video

• Write advertorials and listicles that carry the ad's promise all the way to the sale

• Find winning ads in the Ad Library and adapt them for our avatars

description:

• Research and compare suitable lender products, interest rates, and policies to identify the best-fit options for each client's circumstances.

• Evaluate the financial position of loan applicants to determine borrowing capacity, analysing income, expenses, and existing debt obligations.

• Collect all required documents from loan applicants, including income statements, credit reports, and identification documents, and verify their authenticity and completeness.

• Prepare loan proposals presenting suitable lender options based on the client's situation and lender policies, and ensure all proposals are reviewed with the broker.

• Ensure all documents are accurate, complete, and meet lender requirements prior to lodgement.

mbers to resolve any issues arising during assessment or processing.

• Follow up all cases from formal approval through to settlement, including checking loan documents upon issuance and following up on outstanding settlement conditions.

• Ensure the outgoing financier (OFI) is ready for settlement where applicable (refinances).

• Set up post-settlement action plans and support clients with ongoing loan maintenance enquiries and requests.

• Follow up with clients every six months, handle loan change requests, and apply and confirm cash rebates.

• Conduct birthday and annual reviews, including follow-up on fixed rate expiries.

• Manage construction progress drawdowns: collect and follow up on construction document checklists, follow up on commencement letters, and track construction progress through to completion.

title: Senior AI Video Editor | Amazon Product Videos & Motion Graphics (Part-time, Long-Term)
description:
Hi there!



I am looking for an experienced Amazon Performance Video Editor & Motion Designer to take ownership of the product videos for my e-commerce business.



This is NOT an entry-level position. You should already be highly skilled in editing product videos with motion graphics and text overlays, and in using AI tools to create video content from product images.



Our Amazon listings already have videos, but they were not built for conversion. The first goal is to build a recognizable brand video template and use it to redesign all our existing listing videos. We are also developing new products, so there will be ongoing work after that.



We don't always have video footage available. Often we only have high-quality product photography, so I am looking for someone who is truly AI-capable and can turn product photos into realistic, convincing video content.



> ABOUT THE BUSINESS



I run a growing Dutch e-commerce company with multiple brands selling primarily on Amazon, as well as WooCommerce and eBay.



This role focuses on our action sports brand: surfboard, snowboard and ski wall racks, wetsuit hangers, wetsuit changing mats, surfboard tie-down straps, and soft roof racks.



We sell in 12 Amazon marketplaces. The US is our biggest market, and videos will be versioned into 8 languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Polish, and Swedish.



> OUR VIDEO APPROACH



Our approach is based on research into what converts on Amazon:

• The product in use within the first 2 seconds, no logo intros

• Silent-first: every key message is readable as on-screen text, voiceover is optional

• Mobile-first: large, high-contrast text that is easy to read on a phone

• Real demos over mood: a person in frame for scale, problem to solution, installation and proof

• One clear message per scene and 3-4 key benefits per video

• The same look, structure, and end card across every product



The goal is simple: videos that clearly show the product, work without sound on a phone, and increase CTR and conversion.



> RESPONSIBILITIES



Brand video template (first priority):

• Build a reusable video system: text cards, icon style, transitions, music style, and end card

• Create editable templates (for example Essential Graphics / MOGRTs) so new products and language versions can be produced quickly

• Set up a clean project structure with separate layers for footage, graphics, text per language, music, and voiceover



Product videos:

• Redesign all existing listing videos using the new template

• Create videos for new product launches

• Per product: a 45-60 second listing and A+ video, a 15-20 second Sponsored Brands ad, and 3-5 short silent feature clips (7-15 seconds) for Sponsored Products ads

• Draft short on-screen text and shot lists based on our storyboard structure

• Clearly show size, installation steps, and durability



AI video creation (important):

• Create lifestyle scenes from product photos (a board on a living room wall, a poncho at the beach, straps on a car roof)

• Create hands and usage scenes when we only have packshots

• Add product movement, camera push-ins, and environment shots to support the story

• Make sure the product always looks exactly like the real one: correct shape, colors, logo, and details

• Keep results realistic and natural, not obvious AI or a full CGI video



Localization and compliance:

• Create language versions by swapping text layers and voiceover tracks (we provide the translations)

• Design text cards with room for longer languages and use the right units per market (inches for the US, centimeters for Europe)

• Create AI voiceovers (for example ElevenLabs) and export SRT caption files per language

• Follow Amazon video specs and policies: no prices, promotions, reviews, star ratings, URLs, "best" or "#1" claims, or competitor comparisons

• Only use properly licensed music and keep license proof on file



Organization:

• Keep project files, exports, and assets organized with a clear naming convention

• Maintain a simple tracker for video status and revisions

• Use performance feedback (CTR, conversion) to improve videos over time



> TOOLS



• Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (preferred), or DaVinci Resolve with strong motion graphics skills

• AI video tools such as Veo, Runway, or Kling

• AI image tools such as, ChatGPT, Nano Banana

• AI voiceover tools such as ElevenLabs

• Google Sheets and Microsoft Teams



Tools change fast. What matters is the outcome.



> REQUIREMENTS



• At least 2 years of hands-on experience editing product or e-commerce videos

• Proven experience creating video content from product images with AI tools

• Strong motion graphics and animated text skills

• Experience designing videos for mobile and sound-off viewing

• Experience building reusable templates for consistent branding

• Excellent visual taste: clean, clear hierarchy, not cluttered

• Highly organized: clean files, clean naming, clean versioning

• Reliable, structured, and able to work independently

• Strong written English and clear communication



Amazon video experience (listing videos, A+, Sponsored Brands ads) and multi-language versioning are a strong advantage. Light 3D (Blender or Cinema 4D) is a plus.



I am looking for someone who thinks: "Can a customer understand this product on a muted phone in 5 seconds?" rather than: "Does this look cool?"



> HOURS AND COMPENSATION



• $3-5 USD per hour depending on experience

• No fixed hours, flexible schedule

• At least 10-20 hours per week expected initially (brand template and redesigning all existing videos)

• Ongoing work after that for new product launches

• Weekly sync via Microsoft Teams

• Long-term collaboration preferred, with room to grow in responsibility, hours, and pay



> APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please answer the following:



1. Share 2-3 product videos you created (Amazon listing videos or ads preferred).

2. Share one video where you created scenes from product photos only, using AI. Which tools did you use, and how did you keep the product accurate?

3. How do you make sure a product video still works without sound on a phone?

4. Name 3 things that can get an Amazon video rejected.

5. How many hours per week are you available, and when can you start?

6. Are you comfortable with the $3-5/hour rate?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test task, including AI-generated scenes from our product photos.



Please ONLY apply if you have real experience editing product videos and creating video content with AI.



Applications without examples of previous video work will not be considered.



Cheers,

Friso

title: Wedding Photo Editor | Lightroom Classic | Freelance
description:
Hiring: Freelance Wedding Photo Editor | Lightroom Classic | Project Based



Hi there!



I'm a wedding photographer based in Canada, and I'm looking for a talented and reliable freelance photo editor to help me with my wedding galleries.



I'm specifically looking for someone who can work on a project basis, handle multiple wedding editing projects at a time and consistently meet deadlines without compromising on quality.



I currently have a wedding gallery of around 2,000 photos that needs editing, so I'm hoping to find someone who can start soon!



I've already edited the highlight photos myself, so I'm looking for someone who can use my existing edits as a reference and continue editing the remaining photos in the same style.



I'm hoping to find someone I can build a long term working relationship with for future projects too!



Tasks you'll be helping me with:



* Editing wedding photos using Adobe Lightroom Classic

* Matching my existing editing style as closely as possible

* Correcting exposure, white balance, contrast and colours

* Maintaining natural, true to tone colours and beautiful skin tones

* Keeping the editing consistent throughout the entire wedding gallery

* Working with my existing Lightroom catalogs and Smart Previews

* Paying attention to different lighting situations, including indoor, outdoor, natural light and flash photography

* Making small adjustments or revisions when needed

* Returning the completed Lightroom catalog with all adjustments intact



I'll provide reference photos, my existing edits and guidance on the editing style I'm looking for.



Important: Colour Accurate Monitor Required



Colour accuracy is extremely important to me, especially when it comes to wedding photography and natural skin tones.



**You must have a properly calibrated, colour accurate monitor suitable for professional photo editing.**



Ideally, I'm looking for someone who:



* Uses a colour accurate monitor with at least 99% sRGB coverage

* Has calibrated their monitor using a hardware calibration device such as a Datacolor Spyder or Calibrite

* Understands colour management and consistent colour reproduction

* Can maintain accurate skin tones across different lighting conditions

* Regularly checks and maintains their monitor calibration



Please mention your monitor brand, model and calibration method when applying.



What I am NOT looking for:



* Someone who simply applies a preset to every photo without checking the results

* Someone who completely changes my editing style

* Someone who uses heavy filters, excessive saturation or unnatural skin tones

* Someone who edits on an uncalibrated or unreliable display

* Someone who struggles to manage multiple projects or meet deadlines

* Someone who is disorganized or needs constant reminders

* Someone who has difficulty communicating in English

* Someone who disappears during a project without providing updates

* Someone who relies entirely on AI editing without manually reviewing the photos



What I AM looking for:



Experience is great, but attention to detail, consistency, reliability and meeting deadlines are more important to me.



I'm looking for someone who:



* Has strong experience with Adobe Lightroom Classic

* Understands wedding photography and different lighting conditions

* Can accurately follow and match an existing editing style

* Has a good eye for natural colours, exposure and skin tones

* Uses a properly calibrated, colour accurate editing monitor

* Can comfortably handle multiple wedding galleries at the same time

* Is organized and consistently meets agreed deadlines

* Communicates well in English and provides regular progress updates

* Is open to feedback and willing to make revisions when needed

* Has a reliable computer and fast internet connection

* Can work independently without constant supervision

* Takes client privacy and confidentiality seriously



Work Details & Payment



This is a **freelance, project based position**, not a full time or fixed hourly role.



Most wedding galleries will have around 500 to 2,000 photos.



All photos will already be selected and culled. I'll provide my edited highlight photos as references so you can follow the same editing style throughout the gallery.



The work mainly involves Lightroom colour correction, exposure, white balance, cropping and maintaining consistency. Extensive Photoshop retouching is not included.



**Payment per wedding gallery (CAD):**



* 500 to 1,000 photos: $150

* 1,001 to 1,500 photos: $250

* 1,501 to 2,000 photos: $300



**Expected turnaround:** Ideally 7 Days per wedding.



**Work arrangement:** Fully remote, freelance and project based.



I'm looking for someone who has the capacity to take on multiple wedding galleries when needed while maintaining consistent quality and meeting deadlines.



There may be multiple projects available depending on the workload, so I'm hoping to find someone reliable who would be interested in working together long term.



A small paid test edit will be required before starting our first project.



How to Apply:



If this sounds like something you'd enjoy doing, I'd love to hear from you!



Please include the following in your application:



1. A little introduction about yourself and your photo editing experience

2. A link to your wedding photo editing portfolio, preferably with before and after examples

3. Your experience working with Lightroom Classic catalogs and Smart Previews

4. Are you comfortable with the project rates mentioned above?

5. Your usual turnaround time for 1,000 to 2,000 photos

6. How many wedding galleries can you comfortably handle at the same time?

7. What brand and model of monitor do you use for editing?

8. Is your monitor hardware calibrated? If yes, which calibration device do you use?

9. Your internet connection speed and general availability

10. Are you happy to complete a small paid test edit before starting a full project?

11. Share one of your favourite inspirational quotes and tell me why you like it.

12. What do you enjoy most about photo editing, especially wedding photography?



**One small thing!**



Please start your application with the words **"Wedding Stories"** so I know you've read the full job post. :)



I'm really hoping to find someone who genuinely enjoys photo editing, takes pride in their work and pays attention to the little details.



I value good communication, consistency, reliability and someone who can deliver beautiful work on time.



Looking forward to hearing from you!



Thank you so much!

About You

What To Expect

title: Experienced Bookkeeper for Australian Accounting Practice
description:
EXPERIENCED BOOKKEEPER for AUSTRALIAN Accounting Firm



###   Are you ready to show us your Australian bookkeeping superpowers?

###   We’re excited to meet the right person — is it you?



We are offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Bookkeeper with a solid background in the bookkeeping environment and proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Xero. Join our growing team and deliver high-quality results by following clearly documented systems in a supportive and efficient workplace.  

Experience with Australian GST is essential. 

Join a values-driven accounting team with extra Easter leave available, and a two-week Christmas shutdown!



A. THE ROLE

We are seeking a detail-driven, client-focused bookkeeper who enjoys making a real difference to small businesses. You will be working in a structured, process-oriented environment, where accuracy, productivity and client service are key.

# Client Service Mantra: ACE — Accurate, Cost-effective, and Efficient

# Work Schedule: Monday to Thursday (8:00 am – 5:30 pm AEST, GMT +10) and four hours on Friday



THE ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU IF YOU:

*   Hold formal training in Accounting or Bookkeeping

*   Have SOLID experience in Australian BAS preparation 

*    Understand Australian GST legislation and nuances

*    Love to work as a team with all team members following consistent processes.

*    Love to deliver high-quality work, on time

*    Have a strong grasp of accounting principles and general ledger

*    Communicate clearly in excellent written and spoken English

*    Embrace productivity tools and cloud-based technology (especially QuickBooks Online)

*    Are proactive, solution-focused, and love following procedures

*    Are organised, self-directed, and an efficient time manager

*    Have a strong sense of professional confidentiality and responsibility

*    Can work well under pressure and in a remote team setting

*    Are complimented on your attention to detail and reliability



B.  CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



You’ll work as part of a small, collaborative team, and will be responsible for:

• Bookkeeping and transaction processing for small business clients

• Accurate general ledger and GST allocations

• Bank reconciliation and review of outstanding transactions

• Preparation of Business Activity Statements (BAS)

• Preparation of year-end workpapers for our accountants



Required Skills & Attributes:



• A genuine passion for accounting and numbers

• Strong understanding of debits and credits (this will be tested)

• Ability to follow procedures and grasp the "why" behind tasks

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Tech-savviness — advanced computer skills will be tested



C.  EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



To be considered, you must have:

## A reliable computer (i5 processor or higher) with minimum 8GB RAM preferable MORE.

## At least TO screens, preferably THREE — ideally a laptop + 2 extra screens or a dual-monitor setup

##  A stable internet connection and a reliable internet backup

## A dedicated home workspace with ergonomic chair and proper desk, away from household interruptions 

## A dedicated noise-cancelling headset (not shared)

## A camera for meetings

## A full keyboard with number pad and mouse

## The hard disk of your computer MUST be less than 80% full



D CHILDCARE ARRANGEMENTS



For applicants with children under 8 years old, a dedicated adult carer must be present during all working hours.



E. WHO ARE WE?



We are a tech-forward, Australian-based accounting firm that supports small businesses across the country. 



We value:

 #  Clear communication

#  A love of learning

#  Commitment to maintaining established procedures and processes

#  Confidentiality and integrity

#  Strong teamwork, even in a remote environment



We have well-documented procedures available in our online portal.



F. WORK SCHEDULE, HOLIDAYS & BENEFITS



## 40 hours per week – Monday to Thursday GMT +10 8:00 am to 5:30 pm and 4 hours on Friday morning. 

      (6:00 am to 2:30 pm Philippine time 

## Pro-rata Annual Leave (7%) and Personal Leave (3.5%)

## 2-week Christmas Shutdown 

## Easter Thursday leave available; 1 & 2 November leave available

## Paid for all gazetted Brisbane (Australia) Public Holidays

## Paid every second week in PHP directly to your bank account

## 13th Month Pay (pro-rata after 6 months service)



Pay is commensurate with experience and reviewed regularly.



G. HOW TO GET OUR ATTENTION



We only shortlist applicants who follow these instructions exactly. Please include all four items below in your application:



1)  Subject Line



Your application
 must have the exact subject line:  “Bookkeeper Superstar -  <Your Name>”

## This is essential to get past our screening filters.



2)  CIRRICULUM VITAE



Submit a detailed Curriculum Vitae listing all work and study over the past 5 years, plus a summary of prior experience.

### DO NOT send Canva-style 1-page designs. We want substance over style.



3) COVER LETTER



In your letter, tell us:



a)  When and how you discovered your passion for bookkeeping

b)  What a satisfying day at work looks like for you

c)  An example of how tech improved your work/study

d)  How you manage tasks and deadlines

e)  Details of your QuickBooks Online experience

f)  Your understanding of Australian GST — and how you’ve applied it

g)  The best thing you’ve done in Word and Excel — and how it added value

h)  Your favourite subject studied and how you excelled in it

i)   A time you used English professionally with non-Filipino clients/teams

j)  An example of your “can-do” attitude solving a problem

k)  What excites you about working from home

l)  Your expected salary (in PHP) for a 80-hour fortnight



4)  SHORT VIDEO



Make a 30–60 second video using your mobile phone showing your dedicated workspace.

Tell us:

a) How your setup makes you productive

b) How you will keep it confidential from others in your household
salary: AUD $8 to $12 per hour paid fortnightly

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly proactive, energetic, and creative Digital Marketing Specialist who is passionate about all things digital marketing and has a strong eye for sophisticated, premium-quality design.



The ideal candidate is a hands-on, action-oriented individual who can confidently manage and execute a variety of digital marketing activities across multiple client accounts. This role goes beyond simply creating and scheduling social media posts. You will be involved in managing social media platforms, developing content strategies, coordinating digital advertising campaigns, monitoring marketing performance, preparing reports, managing websites, and implementing basic SEO activities.



A strong creative eye is essential. We are particularly interested in someone who understands luxury and premium brand aesthetics, with the ability to create elegant, polished, and visually engaging marketing materials that reflect a high-end brand identity.



We want someone who is switched on, resourceful, and takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions. Someone who keeps up with digital marketing trends, brings fresh ideas to the table, enjoys working across different platforms, and can confidently manage multiple projects and client requirements in a fast-paced environment.



If you are passionate about digital marketing, have a flair for creative design, and enjoy turning ideas into effective marketing campaigns, we'd love to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Management & Content Marketing



Manage and maintain multiple social media accounts across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Develop and maintain monthly social media content calendars aligned with each client's brand identity, marketing objectives, and target audience.

Create, edit, and publish engaging social media content, including graphics, short-form videos, reels, stories, and other digital assets.

Write compelling captions, marketing copy, and calls to action appropriate for each platform and audience.

Ensure consistency in brand voice, visual identity, and messaging across all social media channels.

Monitor social media engagement, respond to comments and messages, and help build and maintain online communities.

Stay updated with social media trends, platform updates, and emerging content strategies to identify opportunities for growth and engagement.

2. Creative Design & Brand Aesthetics



Create visually compelling, high-quality marketing materials that reflect each client's brand identity and positioning.

Develop sophisticated, polished, and visually cohesive graphics and digital assets, particularly for premium and luxury brands.

Demonstrate a strong eye for typography, colour palettes, composition, spacing, imagery, and visual storytelling.

Transform photos, videos, and other brand assets into refined and engaging marketing content.

Create visually appealing advertising creatives, promotional materials, and branded digital content.

Ensure all creative outputs maintain a consistent, professional, and premium aesthetic across social media, websites, and digital advertising campaigns.

Bring fresh creative concepts and design ideas while maintaining each client's established brand guidelines.

3. Digital Advertising & Campaign Management



Assist in planning, setting up, managing, and monitoring digital advertising campaigns, particularly across Meta Ads and other relevant platforms.

Develop and coordinate advertising creatives, copy, audience targeting, and campaign requirements.

Monitor advertising performance, track key metrics, and identify opportunities to improve campaign results.

Assist with campaign optimisation, budget monitoring, and performance analysis.

Ensure advertising campaigns align with each client's marketing objectives and target audience.

4. Website Management & SEO



Assist with managing and updating client websites, including uploading content, editing pages, and maintaining website information.

Ensure website content is accurate, engaging, visually appealing, and aligned with each client's brand.

Perform basic SEO activities, including keyword research, on-page optimisation, meta titles and descriptions, headings, and internal linking.

Assist with blog uploads, website content optimisation, and other activities that improve online visibility.

Monitor website performance and identify opportunities for improvements.

Identify and report technical or content-related website issues when necessary.

5. Reporting & Marketing Coordination



Prepare regular social media, advertising, and digital marketing performance reports.

Track key performance indicators (KPIs), analyse campaign results, and provide actionable insights.

Maintain organised marketing calendars, content schedules, campaign timelines, and project updates.

Coordinate content and campaign approvals with clients.

Manage revisions, follow-ups, and deadlines to ensure marketing activities are delivered on time.

Monitor the progress and performance of marketing activities across multiple client accounts.

Proactively recommend new ideas, strategies, and opportunities to improve each client's digital presence and marketing results.

Requirements



Previous experience in digital marketing, social media management, or a similar marketing role.

Strong understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing principles, and online audience engagement.

Experience creating and managing social media content and marketing calendars.

Understanding of digital advertising, particularly Meta Ads.

Basic knowledge of website management and SEO principles.

Ability to monitor marketing performance, interpret data, and prepare reports.

Strong creative and visual design skills, with an appreciation for luxury, premium, and sophisticated brand aesthetics.

Excellent eye for detail, composition, typography, colour coordination, and visual presentation.

Ability to create elegant, polished, and professionally designed marketing materials rather than relying solely on generic templates.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities.

Highly proactive, energetic, and action-oriented, with a willingness to take ownership of tasks.

A creative thinker who can bring fresh ideas, identify opportunities, and recommend improvements.

Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly to changing client requirements.

Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and marketing techniques.

Preferred Skills & Tools



Experience with Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager.

Familiarity with Google Ads and Google Analytics 4.

Experience using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar creative tools.

Familiarity with WordPress or other website content management systems.

Knowledge of SEO tools such as Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.

Experience with social media scheduling and reporting tools.

Familiarity with Metricool and Claude.

Experience working with luxury, lifestyle, hospitality, property, fashion, or other premium brands would be an advantage.

Portfolio Requirements



Applicants are encouraged to provide a portfolio showcasing their creative and digital marketing work, particularly:



Luxury or premium brand social media designs.

Sophisticated promotional graphics and digital advertisements.

Short-form video content, reels, and other social media creatives.

Website designs, landing pages, or website content.

Examples of digital marketing campaigns and their performance, where available.

-----------------------------

Opener Always answer with a smile, it matters! ????

(Wait for : This call is being recorded) Hi this is ________ with Sunyhome cleaners. Is this _______? Hey ______ (name), we saw that you requested a quote for a professional home cleaning and I’m just responding to that request. (SET FRAME) So typically how these calls go is I’m going to ask you some questions about your home. Once I get all of that information, I can provide you with an exact quote - sound good?

Information Gathering:______________________________________________________________

Before we get started, let me confirm your
 address… it’s 
 is that correct? And what is the zip code of the home so we can check if we service this area. 

Okay perfect, now how many bedrooms and bathrooms is your home? Do you know the square footage or should I look that up for you?



Do you have any pets in the home?



While I put your information in our system, NAME, I’d love to know what made you reach out to us today?

(be empathetic to their needs, short response sentence here)



I’m working on that quote for you right now, but What date are you looking to get this cleaning done by? 

(If they do not give an exact answer: Do you have a preferred day of the week?)

Okay, we’re pretty booked up over the next month, but let me check if that day is available for you.



When was the last time you had your home professionally cleaned?

If it’s been within the past few months, ask “Out of curiosity, what happened to your previous cleaner?” 



On a scale from 1-10, NAME, 1 being your house is absolutely perfect and spotless and 10 being it’s really dirty, maybe lots of dust, build up, grease, or grime, where would it fall from 1-10?



Diagnose:

Pitch

Perfect, so I know you said you have [Problem], so what we are going to do is go in there and do a really thorough deep clean and make sure the place looks AMAZING from top to bottom. We clean every single room from the light fixtures all the way down to scrubbing the baseboards. We’re gonna take care of this for you [DAY/DATE] so you don’t have to stress or worry about doing this yourself and all of that is going to be just [Price]. ??(STOP TALKING after delivering price)??

Okay sounds good, let’s get the rest of your information so we can get you on our schedule.

On the _______ (date) would 9:30 work for you? Perfect

What is the address we will be doing the cleaning for you?

ONLY If they seem concerned about giving a card on file:

So we won’t be charging you until the cleaning is completely done. There will be 24 hour in advance hold on the funds. But only once the cleaning is completely done will we put the charge through.

Customer says okay. Get all card information

Okay perfect. 2 last questions for you, what type of flooring does your home have?

And what would the parking look like for our cleaners? 

If apartment ask: Is there any visitor parking? 

Is there any street sweeping that day?



***Okay perfect, name, your booking is confirmed. On the confirmation

title: SEO Account Manager (SEO Strategy & On-Page)
description:
Own SEO strategy, research and on-page for a book of US clients, starting from who the customer is, not from a keyword list. 



Rohring Results is a US marketing agency of about thirty people. We run SEO, paid advertising, social and creative, content, web development and custom software for businesses across the US, many of them home-services and local companies. Our delivery team works from the Philippines. 



Our SEO team has four specialists (technical, local, off-page and this seat) under a department lead. This seat owns the thinking: buyer research, competitive benchmarking, keyword and intent strategy, on-page direction, the monthly content plan, and the strategy each client works from. This is not a client-relations role. You will work on the SEO account itself, and our Client Relations team owns the client conversation. 



On our larger clients we run an automated agent that proposes on-page fixes. You approve every change individually, because a fix is only right in the context of the strategy behind it. Client content is drafted by an AI writing engine we built and refined by our Copywriter; you hold the final review before it is published. 



What you will do 



-Research each client's buyers and competitors, and turn that into keyword, intent and topic plans. 

-Approve or reject automated on-page changes one at a time, and hand-build schema on the pages that matter most. 

-Brief the month's content, then review and publish it. 

-Run quarterly site audits and d
 what gets fixed first. 

-D
 what goes to our technical specialist and what goes to our web team, then check it was done. 

-Prepare the inputs for monthly client reports and check the reports before they go out. 



What we are looking for 



-3+ years of hands-on SEO strategy, ideally at an agency with several clients at once. 

-Real research skill: you can read reviews, forums and search data and find the pattern in them. 

-Google Search Console and GA4 at analysis depth. 

-You can write and validate JSON-LD schema by hand. 

-You can write a brief a writer can use, and send back a draft that is not good enough. 

-You would rather tell a client the realistic answer than the encouraging one. 

-Clear written English. 



Nice to have 



Search Atlas or a similar SEO platform. Rank Math. Microsoft Clarity. Bing Webmaster Tools. Local SEO. A considered view of where AI-generated content and reports can be trusted. 



How we work 



-Remote, Philippines-based. Core hours are 9am–1pm Philippine Time every workday. The rest of your hours are flexible within the same day. 



-Time tracking. We track hours in Hubstaff against client projects, so each client gets the time they pay for. It also records activity data, and we do not use that to judge how well you do your job. 



-AI is part of the work. We use AI tools across the company. We want people who use them well and check what comes back, not people who trust them blindly or refuse to use them. 



We are still building. Some of our processes are newer than we would like. You will help shape how this work runs, not only follow a finished playbook. 



How to apply 



Send Applications to 
 with your CV, send short answers (a paragraph each) to these questions. We read these first; they tell us more than a cover letter. 



1. Tell us about a high-volume keyword you deliberately did not target. Why? 



2. An automated tool proposes an on-page change that is technically correct but you think is wrong for this client. What do you do? 



Applications without the answers will not be reviewed.

title: UK Accountant – Balance Sheet Review & Reconciliations (Xero)
description:
We're a London business group: Number 90, a bar, nightclub and events venue in Hackney Wick, and Mainyard Studios, a workspace business with 600+ residents. Mainyard runs each building as its own small company, and most of them are simple: rent in, costs out.



An external firm does most of our bookkeeping and set up our books, and a UK accountant reviews our accounts at year-end. That isn't changing. In-house, Erica handles our finance and credit control. She has grown with the business from building manager to running our numbers day to day.



We're looking for an accountant to join Erica. Your job is to catch problems before they reach our year-end accountant: balance sheet accounts that don't reconcile, payroll and tax payments posted to the wrong place, depreciation not posted, intercompany balances that don't agree. That frees Erica to focus on bigger things, such as negotiating deals.



If you can look at a balance sheet and tell us what's wrong with it, this role is for you.



What you'll do

• Review our companies' balance sheets every month and make sure every line ties to evidence: bank, PAYE, NIC, pensions, VAT, corporation tax, intercompany, loans and deposits

• Check the journals our bookkeeper and accountants post, and get the errors fixed

• Keep Xero up to date with our finance lead at Mainyard Studios: bank reconciliations, invoicing, chasing late payments and checking supplier bills

• Reconcile club nights at Number 90: promoter recharges, tech and PRS costs, supplier overcharges

• Build simple month-end checklists and help with budgets

There's plenty of hands-on reconciliation work. We want it done by someone who understands the whole balance sheet, not just the bank feed.



You must have

• A degree in Accountancy. CPA or audit experience is strongly preferred.

• 3+ years of balance sheet reconciliations and month-end close, ideally across several companies

• Daily, practical Xero experience

• UK experience: you've worked on UK clients' books, or you know UK VAT and payroll (PAYE and NIC) well enough to show us on the call

• Clear written English, and the habit of raising problems without being asked

Nice to have: Xero Advisor certification, hospitality or property experience.



Working hours

Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday. Flexible within the day, with at least 4 hours a day overlapping UK business hours.



Salary & benefits

• Base salary: $1,000 USD per month

• 13th-month pay, pro-rated in your first year

• 20 days' paid holiday a year, inclusive of Philippine public holidays

• Up to 5 paid sick days a year



After passing 3 months' probation:

• Company-funded health insurance

• A quarterly recovery bonus of up to 75% of a month's salary, for money you find and recover that we would otherwise have lost



How to apply

Please do not reply directly to this advert. Create a Google Drive folder titled Your Full Name + Your Superpower, and include:

1. A short video (2 minutes max). Who you are and why this role interests you. Mention your name and today's date. Not a spoken CV.

2. "The Mistake I Found" (10 lines max). A time you found an error someone else made in the accounts: what it was, how you found it, and what you changed so it didn't happen again. Your real experience, not a textbook answer.

3. Your CV, plus your Xero certificate if you have one.

4. Take your DISC profile using this disc and add it to the folder: 
/EndUserAdmin/RegisterMobile.aspx?}]xT

 and

What happens next: shortlisted candidates have a video call where we share a real balance sheet on screen and ask what you'd question. There's no preparation needed. If you know balance sheets, you'll enjoy it.



We use TimeProof for all working hours. It's not there to spy on you. It shows us how long tasks really take, so we can improve our processes. Split your day however suits you, as long as you cover the UK overlap and you're focused on us while you're working. If you're not comfortable with TimeProof, please don't apply.

We’re looking for a YouTube Creative Director who understands what makes content perform—from the first three seconds of a video to the thumbnail, title, retention curve, and final call to action.

title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description:
About the Role 



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked—this role may be for you. 



Rohring Results is a US-based marketing agency providing SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development for clients across multiple industries. 



We are hiring a Strategy Manager to own the strategic direction behind our client work. 



This is not a single-channel marketing role. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan. 



More importantly: 



This is a research job with a strategy title. 



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it. 



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem. 



What You'll Actually Do 



1. Lead Client Strategy 



-You will own the strategy for new clients, including: 

-Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction 

-Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan 

-Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities 

-Determining what should be prioritized and why 

-Translating research into clear strategic recommendations 

-Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives 



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research 



-You will personally conduct or direct research involving: 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Customer personas 

-Competitive analysis 

-Industry and market research 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research for paid campaigns 

-Competitor messaging and offer analysis 

-Market trends and opportunities 



We are looking for someone who actually does the research, not someone who simply delegates it. 



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable. 



3. Build Brand Foundations 



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning. 



You will help establish: 



-Brand positioning 

-Differentiation 

-Target audience 

-Brand voice 

-Key messaging 

-Value propositions 

-Messaging angles 



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables. 



You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why. 



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative 



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client. 



You will: 



-Review content and creative deliverables 

-Identify when something does not align with strategy 

-Give clear and actionable feedback 

-Approve or reject work before client delivery 

-Explain why something needs to change 

-Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy 



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it. 



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy 



You will determine: 



-Target audience 

-Campaign objective 

-Offer 

-Messaging angle 

-Sequence 

-Call to action 



Our copywriter will write the
s. 



You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work. 



6. Analyze Client Performance 



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools. 



But generating a report is only the beginning. 



You will need to determine: 



-What actually happened? 

-Why did it happen? 

-Which numbers matter? 

-Which numbers are misleading? 

-What changed from the previous period? 

-What should we do next? 

-Does the data actually support the story the report is telling? 

-We need someone who can question the report, not just format it. 



AI Is a Major Part of This Role 



Every agency says it uses AI. 



Here's what we actually mean. 



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different. 



Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong. 



You will be expected to: 



-Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries 

-Build effective prompts and research workflows 

-Iterate instead of accepting the first response 

-Cross-check AI-generated information 

-Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations 

-Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know 

-Know when AI should not be used 

-Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate 

-Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources 

-Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true. 



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly. 



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that looked correct but wasn't—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it. 



What You'll Own 



-Overall marketing strategy for new clients 

-Integrated multi-channel strategy 

-Market and industry research 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Brand positioning and differentiation 

-Customer personas 

-Paid advertising audience strategy 

-Content and creative direction 

-Content and creative approval 


 campaign strategy 

-Client performance reporting 

-Strategic recommendations based on performance data 

-Ongoing independent research 

-Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks 

-Dedicated Research Time 



A portion of every week will be protected for research that is not tied to a specific client. 



This is intentional. 



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities. 



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output. 



That's the point. 



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable. 



 

What We're Looking For 



Required 



Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience 



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including: 



-SEO 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Social Media 

-Content Marketing 


 Marketing 

-Brand Strategy 



We are not looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others. 



Strong Research Experience 



You have personally conducted work such as: 



-Market research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Customer research 

-Personas 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research 

-Industry analysis 



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail. 



Genuine Curiosity 

One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity. 

We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it. 

It does not have to be marketing. 

Strong AI Research Skills 

You understand AI as a research and reasoning instrument, not simply a faster way to write. 



You should be comfortable: 

-Prompting 

-Iterating 

-Fact-checking 

-Comparing sources 

-Challenging AI outputs 

-Building repeatable AI research workflows 



We may assess this skill live. 



Strong Critical Thinking 



You naturally ask: 



-How do we know this? 

-What is the source? 

-What assumption are we making? 

-What would prove this wrong? 

-Is there another explanation? 

-What information are we missing? 

-Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback 



You will have authority over work produced by other team members. 



You need to be comfortable saying: 



“This isn't right yet.” 



More importantly, you need to explain exactly what needs to change and why. 



-Self-Directed 

-Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline. 

-You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next. 

-Communication 

-Excellent written English 

-Strong analytical communication 

-Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues 

-Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly 

-Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions 



 



Nice to Have 



Experience with: 

-Digital marketing agencies 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Paid audience and targeting strategy 

-Google Search Console 

-GA4 

-SEO platforms and analytics 

-Marketing dashboards and reporting 

-Competitive intelligence 

-Brand strategy 

-Marketing automation 

-AI research workflows 

-Creating documented processes that another person can follow 



 

What This Job Is NOT 



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for: 



A content writing position 



An SEO specialist position 



A paid ads specialist position 



A social media manager position 



A role where someone else provides the strategy 



A position where you simply execute instructions 



A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster 



Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute. 



You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working. 



 

About the Working Environment 



This is a senior individual contributor position. 



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority. 



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval. 



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered. 



Our delivery team primarily works on Philippine hours, including daily stand-ups. 



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process. 



 



How to Apply 



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following: 



1. A Research Question You Answered Well 



Tell us: 



What were you trying to find out? 



How did you conduct the research? 



What sources did you use? 



How did you evaluate the information? 



How did you know your conclusion was reliable? 



What decision did the research ultimately influence? 



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer 



Tell us about a situation where: 



An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable 



You discovered that it was wrong or misleading 



Explain how you identified the problem 



Explain how you verified the correct information 



Explain what you changed in your process afterward 



We read these answers before the rest of the application. 



Send to 



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.
